abilities.name: Fortifying Brew
abilities.description: Chen drinks from his keg, gaining 50 Brew and 190 (+4% per level) temporary Shields per second, up to a maximum of 570 (+4% per level) while drinking. Shields persist for 4 seconds after he stops drinking.

abilities.name: Flying Kick
abilities.description: Kick through target enemy, dealing 130 (+4% per level) damage.

abilities.name: Keg Smash
abilities.description:
Deal 50 (+4% per level) damage and soak enemies in Brew for 3 seconds, Slowing them by 10%. After 1.25 seconds, the Slow is increased to 40%.

After being used, this Ability becomes Breath of Fire.

Breath of Fire
Deal damage and Ignite Brew-soaked enemies.

abilities.name: Stagger
abilities.description: Damage taken over the next 3 seconds is prevented.  Once this effect ends, Chen receives 75% of the damage taken over 5 seconds. This damage cannot be modified.

abilities.name: Storm, Earth, Fire
abilities.description:
After 1 second, Chen splits into three elemental spirits for 12 seconds, each with 70% of Chen's maximum Health and a unique Ability.  The last spirit Ability that is cast is empowered. If all three spirits are killed, Chen will die as well.

Storm can grant the spirits a Shield. 
Earth can leap to an area and Slow enemies. 
Fire can grant the spirits Attack Speed, damage.

abilities.name: Wandering Keg
abilities.description: Roll around inside an Unstoppable barrel with 70% increased Movement Speed and 25 Armor, dealing 59 (+4% per level) damage to enemies in the way and knocking them back. Lasts for 5 seconds.

abilities.name: Keg Smash - Breath of Fire
abilities.description:
Breathe a cone of flames, dealing 40 (+4% per level) damage. Enemies that are soaked in Brew are Ignited, dealing 342 (+4% per level) additional damage over 6 seconds and adding 1.5 seconds to the duration of the Slow from Keg Smash. 

After being used or after 6 seconds, this ability becomes Keg Smash.

Keg Smash
Damage and Slow enemies.

abilities.name: Storm, Earth, Fire - Storm
abilities.description:
The spirits gain a Shield for 400 (+4% per level) over 3 seconds.

If this is the final Ability cast, the shield amount is increased to 750 (+4% per level) with no limited duration, and the duration of Storm, Earth, Fire is increased by 5 seconds.

abilities.name: Storm, Earth, Fire - Earth
abilities.description:
Fire and Earth leap to the target location, dealing 32 (+4% per level) damage and Slowing enemies in a large area by 70% for 1.5 seconds.

If this is the final Ability cast, increase the damage dealt by 300% and instead of Slowing, the leap Roots enemy Heroes hit for 1.75 seconds.

abilities.name: Storm, Earth, Fire - Fire
abilities.description:
Increase the Attack Speed and Basic Attack damage of the spirits by 50% for 5 seconds.

If this is the final Ability cast, the Attack Speed and damage bonus is increased to 75% and the spirits gain 50% Movement Speed for its duration.

abilities.name: Shield Overload
abilities.description: After taking damage while below 75% Health, Artanis gains a 365 (+4% per level) Shield for 5 seconds. Basic Attacks lower the cooldown of Shield Overload by 4 seconds.

abilities.name: Blade Dash
abilities.description: Dash forward and deal 63 (+4% per level) damage to enemies, then return and deal 171 (+4% per level) damage. Every enemy hit reduces the cooldown on Shield Overload by 1 second, and Heroes by 2 seconds.

abilities.name: Twin Blades
abilities.description: Artanis's next Basic Attack immediately causes him to charge a short distance and strike the enemy 2 times.

abilities.name: Phase Prism
abilities.description: Fire a Phase Prism that deals 66 (+4% per level) damage to the first Hero hit and swaps Artanis's position with theirs. Hitting a Hero also grants Artanis Unstoppable for 1.5 seconds. Can be used during Blade Dash.

abilities.name: Purifier Beam
abilities.description: Target an enemy Hero with an orbital beam from the Spear of Adun, dealing 184 (+4% per level) damage per second for 8 seconds. The beam will chase the target as they move. Unlimited range.

abilities.name: Suppression Pulse
abilities.description: Fire a large area pulse from the Spear of Adun, dealing 114 (+4% per level) damage and Blinding enemies for 4 seconds. Unlimited range.

abilities.name: Mech Mode
abilities.description:
When D.Va's Mech dies, she is ejected out after 0.75 seconds and can continue to fight. D.Va's Mech only awards 50% of a normal Hero's experience upon dying.

Fusion Cannons

D.Va's Mech Basic Attacks deal 22 (+4% per level) damage in a large area every 0.25 seconds. Deals 40% bonus damage against enemies very close to the Mech.

abilities.name: Boosters
abilities.description:
Increase D.Va's Movement Speed by 115% for 1.75 seconds. Enemies that are hit take 135 (+4% per level) damage and are knocked away. 

D.Va cannot be Slowed while Boosters are active, and each enemy can only be hit once per use.

abilities.name: Defense Matrix
abilities.description:
Project a defensive field in the target direction for 3 seconds, reducing the damage dealt by enemy Heroes inside it by 60%.

Activate again to change the angle of projection.

Damage dealt to the Mech from enemies within Defense Matrix still grants the same amount of Self-Destruct Charge.

abilities.name: Self-Destruct
abilities.description:
Eject from the Mech, setting it to self-destruct after 4 seconds. Deals 400 (+4% per level) to 1100 (+4% per level) damage in a large area, depending on distance from center. Deals 50% damage against Structures.

Gain 1% Charge for every 2 seconds spent Basic Attacking, and 25% Charge per 100% of Mech Health lost.

abilities.name: Bunny Hop
abilities.description:
D.Va's Mech becomes Unstoppable and stomps every 0.5 seconds, dealing 78 (+4% per level) damage in a large area. Every 4th consecutive hit on a Hero deals 80% more damage and Stuns them for 0.5 seconds.

Lasts for 4 seconds.

Requires Mech Mode.

abilities.name: Micro Missiles
abilities.description:
After .375 seconds, Channel to launch a volley of 12 missiles in a target direction. Each missile impacts the first enemy in its path, dealing 40 (+4% per level) damage in a small area and Slowing by 30% for 2 seconds.

Stores 2 charges with a 3 second cooldown between each use.

Requires Mech Mode.

abilities.name: Mechanized Walker
abilities.description: D.Va's Mech can shoot while moving. While shooting or channeling an ability, the Mech's Movement Speed is quickly reduced by 25%.

abilities.name: Torpedo Dash
abilities.description: Dash towards the target location, passing through enemies along the way.

abilities.name: Concussive Pulse
abilities.description: Deal 120 (+4% per level) damage to enemies in a cone and knock them back.

abilities.name: Call Mech
abilities.description:
Call a new Mech and enter Mech Mode.

Basic Attacks lower this cooldown by 0.5 seconds each.

abilities.name: Big Shot
abilities.description:
Deal 150 (+4% per level) damage to all enemies in a line. Heroes hit have their Movement Speed Slowed by 25% for 1.5 seconds. The cooldown of Call Mech is reduced by 5 seconds for each enemy Hero hit.

Requires Pilot Mode.

abilities.name: Pilot Mode
abilities.description: Basic Attacks reduce the cooldown of Call Mech by 0.5 seconds. As a Pilot, D.Va only awards 50% of a normal Hero's experience upon dying.

abilities.name: Essence Collection
abilities.description:
Heal Dehaka for 29 (+4% per level) Health per stored Essence over 5 seconds. Can be cast during Drag and Burrow.

Passive: Gain 10 Essence from Takedowns and 2 Essence from nearby Minions dying. Maximum of 50 Essence.

abilities.name: Drag
abilities.description:
Dehaka lashes out his tongue, dealing 160 (+4% per level) damage to the first enemy hit, Stunning and dragging them with him for 1.75 seconds.

If Dehaka is Stunned or Silenced while using Drag, the effect ends.

abilities.name: Dark Swarm
abilities.description: Deal 48 (+4% per level) damage every 0.5 seconds to nearby enemies for 3.5 seconds. While active, you are able to move through units. Can be cast during Drag and Burrow.

abilities.name: Burrow
abilities.description: Burrow into the ground, entering Stasis and becoming Invulnerable for 2 seconds. While Burrowed, Dehaka can move at 50% movement speed.

abilities.name: Isolation
abilities.description: Launch biomass that hits the first enemy Hero dealing 200 (+4% per level) damage, revealing, Silencing, and Slowing them 30% for 3 seconds. Additionally, their vision radius is greatly reduced for 6 seconds.

abilities.name: Adaptation
abilities.description: After 4 seconds, heal for 100% of the damage Dehaka took over this period.

abilities.name: Brushstalker
abilities.description:
Activate to burrow to a bush on the Battleground.

Passive: Gain 20% movement speed while in a bush and for 2 seconds after leaving. 

Passive: Gathering a Regeneration Globe reduces the cooldown of Brushstalker by 40 seconds.

abilities.name: Aspect of Death
abilities.description:
Deathwing is fitted with 4 Armor Plates which grant 10 Armor each. Every 25% Health lost causes Deathwing to lose a plate. Plates are only restored when Dragonflight is used, based on the amount of Health Deathwing has when landing.

Deathwing is also a mighty Dragon Aspect who is permanently Unstoppable and deals 100% additional Spell Damage to Heroes, but views his allies with contempt and ignores any of their friendly effects.

abilities.name: Molten Flame
abilities.description: After 1.5 seconds, Deathwing breathes a stream of flame, dealing 20 (+4% per level) damage every 0.125 seconds. Drains 30 Energy per second.

abilities.name: Incinerate
abilities.description:
After 0.75 seconds, Deathwing flaps his wings, dealing 100 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies.

World Breaker: Lava Burst
Create a lava pool that damages and Slows

abilities.name: Lava Burst
abilities.description:
After a 1 second delay, deal 35 (+4% per level) damage to all enemies in an area and create a pool of magma that deals 28 (+4% per level) damage per second and Slows enemies by 45%. Lasts 6 seconds.

Destroyer: Incinerate
Damage enemies near Deathwing

abilities.name: Cataclysm
abilities.description:
After 2 seconds, Deathwing flies in the targeted direction, dealing 90 (+4% per level) damage on impact and leaving scorched ground that deals 36 (+4% per level) damage a second. Lasts 6 seconds.

Quest: Hit Heroes with Molten Flame to grant 1 stack.
Quest: Score Takedowns to grant 50 stacks.

Mythic Reward: After reaching 2000 stacks, Deathwing brings on the Hour of Twilight. Cataclysm's periodic damage to Structures is increased by 2500%.

abilities.name: Dragonflight
abilities.description: After 3 seconds, fly into the sky, becoming Immune to all effects and gaining 2.5% Health per second. Once cast, this ability cannot be interrupted. Cannot be cast for 6 seconds after taking damage, Basic Attacking or casting an Ability.

abilities.name: World Breaker - Onslaught
abilities.description:
After 0.5 seconds, Deathwing lunges in a direction dealing 60 (+4% per level) damage to enemies and Slowing them by 35% for 2 seconds. Deathwing bites enemies at the end of the lunge, dealing an additional 120 (+4% per level) damage.

World Breaker: Earth Shatter
Damage and Stun enemies in two lines

abilities.name: World Breaker - Earth Shatter
abilities.description:
Create a fissure of earth that deals 90 (+4% per level) damage to enemies hit and Stuns them for 0.75 seconds.

Destroyer: Onslaught
Lunge in a direction

abilities.name: Dragonflight - Destroyer
abilities.description: After 1.75 seconds, Deathwing slams down to the ground, dealing 50 (+4% per level) damage to enemies in the area and landing in Destroyer form. Deathwing can begin to cast Abilities 3 seconds after landing.

abilities.name: Dragonflight - World Breaker
abilities.description: After 1.75 seconds, Deathwing slams down to the ground, dealing 50 (+4% per level) damage to enemies in the area and landing in World Breaker form. Deathwing can begin to cast Abilities 3 seconds after landing.

abilities.name: Reduce, Reuse, Recycle
abilities.description:
Regenerate 1 Scrap every 4 seconds. Destroyed Rock-It! Turrets drop 1 Scrap, which can be picked up.

Activate to destroy a target Rock-It! Turret.

abilities.name: Rock-It! Turret
abilities.description:
Create a turret that deals 43 (+4% per level) damage. Loses Health over 20 seconds. 

Turrets prioritize the nearest enemy Hero when first created.

abilities.name: Deth Lazor
abilities.description: After 0.65 seconds, deal 175 (+4% per level) damage to enemies in a line. Heal for 25% of the damage dealt, increased to 75% against enemy Heroes.

abilities.name: Xplodium Charge
abilities.description: Place a bomb that deals 142 (+4% per level) damage to enemies within the target area after 1.25 seconds. Enemies hit are also Stunned for 1 second.

abilities.name: Robo-Goblin
abilities.description:
Activate to become Unstoppable for 1.5 seconds. 

Passive: Basic Attacks deal 100 (+4% per level) bonus damage over 5 seconds, stacking up to 3 times.

abilities.name: Grav-O-Bomb 3000
abilities.description: After a 1.5 second delay, pull enemies toward the center of an area, dealing 220 (+4% per level) damage and Stunning them for 0.5 seconds. Basic Abilities deal 30% more damage for 5 seconds after casting Grav-O-Bomb 3000.

abilities.name: Focus Turrets!
abilities.description: Orders any nearby Rock-It! Turrets to focus the target.

abilities.name: Loot Hoard
abilities.description:
Toss a pile of junk onto the battlefield, dealing 102 (+4% per level) damage in an area, knocking enemies away, and acting as terrain for up to 5 seconds.

When the Loot Hoard expires or is destroyed, a chunk of Meat falls out that can be picked up to restore 3% of maximum Health every second for 4 seconds.

Reactivate to destroy Loot Hoard.

abilities.name: Staggering Blow
abilities.description: Swing your chain in a wide arc, dealing 140 (+4% per level) damage to enemies hit and knocking them away. If an enemy hits terrain, deal an additional 150 (+4% per level) damage, Stun for 0.75 seconds, and gain 15 Rage.

abilities.name: Ez-Thro Dynamite
abilities.description:
Toss a bundle of Dynamite with a 1.5 second fuse. Upon detonation, enemies take 180 (+4% per level) damage and are Slowed by 30% for 2 seconds. 

The Dynamite instantly detonates when landing on an enemy Hero granting Hogger 10 Rage.

abilities.name: Hogg Wild
abilities.description:
After 0.25 seconds, become Unstoppable and uncontrollably spin towards the target direction, ricocheting off terrain. Ricocheting off terrain refreshes the duration.

Every 0.125 seconds, deal 44 (+4% per level) damage to nearby non-Structure enemies. Damage against Heroes is increased by .5% for each point of Rage.

abilities.name: Hoardapult
abilities.description:
Launch an empowered Loot Hoard with Hogger attached, dealing 100 (+4% per level) damage and Slowing enemies by 50% for 2 seconds.

Hoardapult's Loot Hoard lasts for up to 20 seconds, decaying rapidly while not nearby. Every 10 seconds Hogger can take a chunk of Meat from the Loot Hoard.

abilities.name: Shockwave
abilities.description: After 0.5 seconds, slam the ground, sending out a shockwave that travels in a long line. Enemies hit by the initial slam take 335 (+4% per level) damage and are Stunned for 1.5 seconds. Enemies only hit by the shockwave take 230 (+4% per level) damage and are Stunned for 0.75 seconds.

abilities.name: Undying
abilities.description:
Leoric becomes a ghost when he dies, and resurrects upon reaching full Health. Leoric deals no damage while dead.

Wrath Of The Bone King

Leoric's first two Basic Attacks cleave for 100% damage, and his third Basic Attack deals 225% damage to a single target.

abilities.name: Skeletal Swing
abilities.description: Leoric swings his mace, dealing 150 (+4% per level) damage and Slowing enemies by 40% for 2.5 seconds. If an enemy Hero is hit, refund 50% of the cooldown and Mana cost. Deals 75% additional damage to Minions. Peasants!

abilities.name: Drain Hope
abilities.description: Grab an enemy Hero's soul, dealing up to 20% of their maximum Health as damage and healing Leoric for up to 20% of his maximum Health while he is nearby, over 4 seconds. Leoric's Movement Speed is reduced by 20% while this is active.

abilities.name: Wraith Walk
abilities.description: Leoric separates from his body, becoming Unstoppable and gaining Movement Speed accelerating up to 50% over 2.5 seconds. When Wraith Walk ends or is canceled, his body jumps to his wraith.

abilities.name: Entomb
abilities.description: Create an unpassable tomb for 4 seconds.

abilities.name: March of the Black King
abilities.description: Leoric becomes Unstoppable and walks forward, swinging his mace 3 times. Enemies hit take 250 (+4% per level) damage, and Heroes hit heal Leoric for 12% of his maximum Health.

abilities.name: Undying - Ghastly Swing
abilities.description: Slow enemies by 40% for 2.5 seconds.

abilities.name: Undying - Drain Essence
abilities.description: Throw out a chain, attaching to the first enemy Hero hit, healing Leoric for up to 10% of his maximum Health over 4 seconds as long as the enemy remains close.

abilities.name: Reaper's Mark
abilities.description: Basic Attacks cleave in an area in front of Malthael and afflict non-Structure targets with Reaper's Mark for 4 seconds. Marked enemies are revealed and take damage equal to 2% of their maximum Health every 1 second.

abilities.name: Soul Rip
abilities.description: Extract the souls of nearby enemies afflicted by Reaper's Mark, dealing 100 (+4% per level) damage and healing Malthael for 25 (+4% per level) per target hit. Heroic targets heal Malthael for an additional 4% of the Hero's maximum Health.

abilities.name: Wraith Strike
abilities.description: Instantly teleport through an enemy afflicted by Reaper's Mark, dealing 59 (+4% per level) damage and refreshing Reaper's Mark.

abilities.name: Death Shroud
abilities.description: After 0.25 seconds, unleash a wave of dark mist that applies Reaper's Mark to enemies it hits.

abilities.name: Tormented Souls
abilities.description:
Unleash a torrent of souls, continually applying Reaper's Mark to nearby enemies for 4 seconds.

Tormented Souls resets the cooldown of Wraith Strike when activated, and while active, Wraith Strike costs no Mana its cooldown is reduced to 2 seconds.

abilities.name: Last Rites
abilities.description:
Apply a death sentence to an enemy Hero that, after 2 seconds, deals damage equal to 50% of their missing Health.

Quest: Enemies killed between the application of Last Rites and within 1.5 seconds of it dealing damage permanently reduce its cooldown by 5 seconds, to a minimum of 20 seconds.

abilities.name: Valorous Brand
abilities.description: Each Basic Ability marks enemy Heroes hit for 10 seconds. Basic Attacks consume the target's marks, dealing 20% bonus damage per mark and healing for 75 (+4% per level) per mark.

abilities.name: Celestial Charge
abilities.description: Lunge towards a targeted direction and stab, dealing 35 (+4% per level) damage. If an enemy Hero is hit, Channel to Stun for 1 second and deal 80 (+4% per level) additional damage when it fully finishes.

abilities.name: Solarion's Fire
abilities.description: Release a fiery wave that deals 110 (+4% per level) damage. Enemies hit by the center take 50% bonus damage and are Slowed by 40% for 3 seconds.

abilities.name: Molten Armor
abilities.description: Shroud Imperius in flames for 3 seconds, striking a nearby enemy for 19 (+4% per level) damage every 0.25 seconds. Imperius heals for 50% of the damage dealt, increased to 100% against Heroes. Strikes 2 additional targets if no Heroes are in range, and restores 1 Mana for each strike on expiration.

abilities.name: Angelic Armaments
abilities.description:
Summon a ring of blazing swords that grants 850 (+4% per level) Shield for 3 seconds.

If the Shield lasts the full duration, this ability can be reactivated within 5 seconds to launch 6 swords toward an area, each dealing 140 (+4% per level) damage to the first enemy hit.

abilities.name: Wrath of the Angiris
abilities.description:
After 0.75 seconds, charge in the target direction, lifting the first enemy Hero hit into the Heavens. While in the air, Imperius can steer the landing location by moving.

After 2 seconds, slam the target into the ground, dealing 250 (+4% per level) damage to them, increased by 20% for each Valorous Brand on the target when landing, and Stunning them for 1 second.

abilities.name: Misha, Focus!
abilities.description:
Passive: Misha gains 15% move speed. 

Command Misha to attack a specific enemy or move to a point and wait.

Targeting Rexxar commands Misha to retreat to his position, gaining 30% move speed until she reaches Rexxar.

Targeting Misha commands her to hold her current position.

abilities.name: Spirit Swoop
abilities.description: Deal 141 (+4% per level) damage to enemies in a line, slowing them by 30% for 2 seconds.

abilities.name: Misha, Charge!
abilities.description: Misha charges in a line, dealing 150 (+4% per level) damage and stunning enemies for 1.25 seconds.

abilities.name: Mend Pet
abilities.description: Heal Misha for 714 (+4% per level) Health over 5 seconds.

abilities.name: Unleash the Boars
abilities.description: Release a herd of boars that track down all enemy Heroes in a direction, dealing 110 (+4% per level) damage, revealing, and slowing enemies by 40% for 5 seconds.

abilities.name: Bestial Wrath
abilities.description: Increases Misha's Basic Attack damage by 200% for 12 seconds.

abilities.name: Molten Core
abilities.description:
Channel on an allied or destroyed Fort or Keep to replace it with Ragnaros's ultimate form, temporarily gaining new Abilities, having 5000 (+4% per level) Health that burns away over 23 seconds.  Ragnaros's ability ranges increase over the duration of Molten Core.

Ragnaros returns to his normal form but is Stunned for 1 second upon losing all Health in Molten Core.

abilities.name: Empower Sulfuras
abilities.description:
Ragnaros's next Basic Attack is instant, dealing 191 (+4% per level) Ability damage in an area, and heals for 20% of the damage dealt. Healing doubled versus Heroes.

Molten Core: Molten Swing
Stun and damage nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Living Meteor
abilities.description:
Vector Targeting
Summon a meteor at the target point that deals 68 (+4% per level) damage, then rolls in the target direction dealing 272 (+4% per level) damage per second for 1.75 seconds.

Molten Core: Meteor Shower
Drop a line of meteor impacts.

abilities.name: Blast Wave
abilities.description:
Ignite Ragnaros or an ally, granting 25% Movement Speed for 1.5 seconds before exploding dealing 120 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies.

Molten Core: Explosive Rune
Cause a delayed explosion in a large area.

abilities.name: Sulfuras Smash
abilities.description:
Hurl Sulfuras at the target area, landing after 0.75 seconds, dealing 250 (+4% per level) damage. Enemies in the center take 594 (+4% per level) damage instead and are Stunned for 0.5 seconds.

Quest: Hit 8 enemy Heroes in the center.

Mythic Reward: Sulfuras Smash gains an additional charge.

abilities.name: Lava Wave
abilities.description: Release a wave of lava from Ragnaros's Core that travels down the targeted lane, dealing 240 (+4% per level) damage per second to non-Structure enemies in its path and instantly killing enemy Minions. Damage increased by 100% versus Heroes.

abilities.name: Molten Swing
abilities.description: Swing Sulfuras in a wide arc, dealing 250 (+4% per level) damage and Stunning enemies for 1 second.

abilities.name: Meteor Shower
abilities.description:
Vector Targeting
Summon 3 meteors at the target point that fall in the target direction. Each meteor deals 200 (+4% per level) damage and Slows enemies by 35% for 2 seconds.

abilities.name: Explosive Rune
abilities.description: Create a rune that erupts after 1.5 and sets enemies on fire, dealing 22 (+4% per level) damage per second for 5 seconds.

abilities.name: Frostwolf Resilience
abilities.description: Dealing damage with Abilities grants 1 stack of Frostwolf Resilience. At 5 stacks, Thrall is instantly healed for 240 (+4% per level) Health.

abilities.name: Chain Lightning
abilities.description: Shock an enemy with lightning, dealing 170 (+4% per level) damage. The lightning then bounces 3 times to nearby enemies, dealing 85 (+4% per level) damage to each enemy hit.

abilities.name: Feral Spirit
abilities.description: Unleash a Feral Spirit that deals 153 (+4% per level) damage to enemies in its path and Roots Heroes hit for 1 second. Each Hero hit increases the distance traveled by 25%.

abilities.name: Windfury
abilities.description: Increase Thrall's Movement Speed by 30% for 4 seconds. His next 3 Basic Attacks occur 100% faster and generate stacks of Frostwolf Resilience.

abilities.name: Sundering
abilities.description: After 0.5 seconds, sunder the earth in a long line, dealing 290 (+4% per level) damage and shoving enemies to the side, Stunning them for 1 second.

abilities.name: Earthquake
abilities.description: After 0.5 seconds, summon a massive Earthquake that pulses every 4 seconds. Each pulse lasts 2 seconds, Slowing all enemies in the area by 50%, and deals 50 (+4% per level) damage to enemy Heroes. Does 3 pulses.

abilities.name: Heroic Strike
abilities.description: Every 18 seconds, Varian's next Basic Attack deals 125 (+4% per level) bonus Spell Damage. Basic Attacks reduce this cooldown by 3 seconds.

abilities.name: Lion's Fang
abilities.description: Create a shockwave that travels in a straight line, dealing 150 (+4% per level) damage and Slowing enemies by 35% for 1.5 seconds. Each enemy hit heals Varian for 35 (+4% per level), increased to 140 (+4% per level) against Heroes.

abilities.name: Parry
abilities.description:
Parry all incoming Basic Attacks for 1.25 seconds, reducing their damage by 100%.

Stores up to 2 charges.

abilities.name: Charge
abilities.description: Charge to the target enemy, dealing 50 (+4% per level) damage and Slowing them by 75% for 1 second.

abilities.name: Taunt
abilities.description:
Silence a target Hero and force them to attack Varian for 1.25 seconds.

Passive: Maximum Health and Health Regeneration increased by 40%.

abilities.name: Colossus Smash
abilities.description:
Smash a target enemy, dealing 185 (+4% per level) damage and lowering their Armor by 25 for 3 seconds, causing them to take 25% increased damage.

Passive: Base Attack Damage increased by 100%.
Passive: Maximum Health and Health Regeneration reduced by 10%.

abilities.name: Twin Blades of Fury
abilities.description:
Basic Attacks reduce Heroic Strike's cooldown by an additional 7 seconds, and increase Varian's Movement Speed by 30% for 2 seconds.

Passive: Attack Speed increased by 100%.
Passive: Base Attack Damage reduced by 25%.

abilities.name: Divine Purpose
abilities.description:
Activate to instantly charge Yrel's next Basic Ability at no mana cost. Divine Purpose's cooldown is reduced by 3 seconds if Stunned or Silenced while charging her skills.

Passive: Yrel's Basic Abilities charge up over 1.5 seconds, increasing in effectiveness, but reducing Yrel's Movement Speed by 25%.

abilities.name: Vindication
abilities.description:
Unleash holy energy around Yrel, dealing 48 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies and healing her for 111 (+4% per level).

Charging up this Ability increases its damage up to 160 (+4% per level), and healing up to 370 (+4% per level).

abilities.name: Righteous Hammer
abilities.description:
Swing Yrel's hammer, dealing 42 (+4% per level) damage to enemies in front of her and knocking them away.

Charging up this Ability increases its knockback distance, and damage up to 140 (+4% per level). Enemies hit at maximum charge are Stunned for 1 seconds.

abilities.name: Avenging Wrath
abilities.description:
Leap to a location, dealing 260 (+4% per level) damage to enemies in an area and Slowing them by 60% for 1 second.

Charging up this Ability increases its range.

abilities.name: Ardent Defender
abilities.description: Surround Yrel in a barrier for 3 seconds, absorbing all damage taken and healing her for 50% of the damage received.

abilities.name: Sacred Ground
abilities.description: Yrel sanctifies the ground around her, gaining 50 Armor until she leaves the area.

abilities.name: Raise Skeleton
abilities.description: When a nearby enemy Minion dies, it becomes a Skeletal Warrior with 240 (+4% per level) Health that attacks for 21 (+4% per level) damage and lasts up to 12 seconds. Upon death, Skeletal Warriors deal 40 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies.  Up to 3 Skeletal Warriors can be active at once when spawned in this way.

abilities.name: Spectral Scythe
abilities.description: Summon a scythe that travels to Xul after 1 second, dealing 190 (+4% per level) damage to enemies and spawning a Skeletal Warrior when hitting enemy Heroes.  These do not count towards Xul's Raise Skeleton maximum.

abilities.name: Cursed Strikes
abilities.description: Xul's Basic Attacks deal damage in a wide area and reduce the Attack Speed of Heroes and Summons by 40% for 2 seconds. Lasts 4 seconds once triggered.

abilities.name: Bone Prison
abilities.description: After a 2 second delay, deal 80 (+4% per level) damage and Root the target enemy Hero for 1.75 seconds.  All nearby Skeletal Warriors will fixate on the target for their duration.

abilities.name: Skeletal Mages
abilities.description:
Vector Targeting
Summon 4 Frost Mages in a line that attack nearby enemies for 47 (+4% per level) damage a second and Slow them by 30% for 2 seconds. Last up to 15 seconds.

abilities.name: Poison Nova
abilities.description: After 0.5 seconds, release poisonous missiles that deal 630 (+4% per level) damage to all enemies hit over 10 seconds.

abilities.name: Bone Armor
abilities.description: Activate to gain a Shield equal to 25% of Xul's maximum Health for 3 seconds.

abilities.name: Fury
abilities.description: Use Fury instead of Mana, which is gained by taking damage or dealing Basic Attack damage. Using a Basic or Heroic Ability grants 10% Movement Speed for 4 seconds.

abilities.name: Ancient Spear
abilities.description: Throw out a spear that pulls Sonya to the first enemy hit, dealing 173 (+4% per level) damage and briefly stunning them. If this hits an enemy, generate 40 Fury.

abilities.name: Seismic Slam
abilities.description: Deals 176 (+4% per level) damage to the target enemy, and 44 (+4% per level) to enemies behind the target.

abilities.name: Whirlwind
abilities.description: Deals 138 (+4% per level) damage a second to nearby enemies for 3 seconds, healing for 25% of damage dealt. Healing tripled versus Heroes.

abilities.name: Leap
abilities.description: Leap into the air, dealing 135 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies, and stunning them for 1.25 seconds.

abilities.name: Wrath of the Berserker
abilities.description: Increase damage dealt by 40%. Reduce the duration of Stuns, Roots, and Slows against Sonya by 50%. Lasts 15 seconds, and extends by 1 second for every 10 Fury gained.

abilities.name: Dragonqueen
abilities.description:
After 1.25 seconds, transform into a dragon and gain 500 (+4% per level) Health.

While Dragonqueen is active, Alexstrasza's Abilities are empowered, and her Basic Attacks deal 143 (+4% per level) damage and heal allied Heroes for 43 (+4% per level) in an arc in front of her. Additionally, the duration of incoming Stuns, Roots, and Slows, is reduced by 50%.

Lasts 15 seconds.

abilities.name: Gift of Life
abilities.description:
Sacrifice 15% of Alexstrasza's current Health, healing an allied Hero for 150% of that amount.

Passive: Increase Alexstrasza's Health regeneration by 150%.

Dragonqueen: Breath of Life
Cooldown greatly reduced and does not cost Health.

abilities.name: Abundance
abilities.description:
Plant a seed of healing that blooms after 3 seconds, healing nearby allied Heroes for 20% of their maximum Health.

Dragonqueen: Preservation
Heal area and amount greatly increased.

abilities.name: Flame Buffet
abilities.description:
Launch a fireball, Burning enemies hit for 75 (+4% per level) damage over 5.5 seconds.

Hitting enemies that are already Burning deals 125 (+4% per level) bonus damage upon impact, Slows them by 40% decaying over 2 seconds, and refunds the Mana cost.

Dragonqueen: Wing Buffet
Damage and Knockback enemies in an arc.

abilities.name: Life-Binder
abilities.description:
Bind Alexstrasza's life force with an allied Hero. Both her and her target are healed for 480 (+4% per level) Health over 2 seconds. Afterwards, the Hero with a lower percentage of Health is healed to the same Health percentage as the other Hero.

Dragonqueen: Cast range increased by 45%.

abilities.name: Cleansing Flame
abilities.description:
After 1.25 seconds, take to the sky and drop 5 fireballs over 6 seconds at the position of the mouse cursor. Fireballs deal 135 (+4% per level) damage to enemies and heal allied Heroes for 300 (+4% per level) Health.

2 seconds after dropping all fireballs, Alexstrasza lands at the position of the mouse cursor.

abilities.name: Breath of Life
abilities.description:
Heal an allied Hero for 15% of Alexstrasza's current Health.

Breath of Life is also empowered by Gift of Life Talents.

abilities.name: Preservation
abilities.description:
Plant a seed of healing that blooms after 3 seconds, healing nearby allied Heroes for 25% of their maximum Health.

Preservation is also empowered by Abundance Talents.

abilities.name: Wing Buffet
abilities.description: Deal 150 (+4% per level) damage to enemies in an area, knocking them back and Slowing them by 50% for 3 seconds.

abilities.name: Shrike
abilities.description:
Basic Attacks apply a Dose to enemies, dealing 40 (+4% per level) damage over 5 seconds, plus additional damage equal to the current number of stacks on the target, stacking up to 5 times. Every 0.5 seconds, Ana is healed for 60% of the damage dealt by Shrike.

Aim Down Sights

Activating Shrike reduces your Movement Speed by 25%, but increases the Range of Healing Dart and Sleep Dart by 25% while also allowing them to pierce one Hero. Lasts until canceled.

abilities.name: Healing Dart
abilities.description: Fire a dart which heals the first allied Hero hit for 195 (+4% per level) Health. Does not affect full Health Heroes.

abilities.name: Biotic Grenade
abilities.description:
Toss a grenade at the target area. Allied Heroes hit are healed for 152 (+4% per level) Health and receive 25% increased healing from Ana for 4 seconds. Enemies hit take 60 (+4% per level) damage and receive 100% less healing for 1.75 seconds.

If Biotic Grenade does not hit any enemies, reduce its cooldown by 3 seconds, and if Ana is the only target hit, reduce its cooldown by an additional 2 seconds.

abilities.name: Sleep Dart
abilities.description:
Fire a dart that puts the first enemy Hero hit to Sleep, Stunning them for 3 seconds. Sleep's effects end instantly if the target takes damage after the first 0.5 seconds.

Cannot be used on Vehicles.

abilities.name: Nano Boost
abilities.description:
Instantly boost an allied Hero, restoring 200 Mana. For the next 8 seconds, they gain 30% Spell Power and their Basic Ability cooldowns recharge 150% faster.

Cannot be used on Ana.

abilities.name: Eye of Horus
abilities.description:
Assume a sniping position, gaining the ability to fire up to 6 specialized rounds with unlimited range. Rounds pierce allied and enemy Heroes but collide with enemy Structures in their path. Allies are healed for 225 (+4% per level) and enemies are damaged for 135 (+4% per level). Deals 50% less damage to Structures.

Ana is unable to move while Eye of Horus is active.

abilities.name: Eye of Horus - High Powered Round
abilities.description: Fire a specialized round with unlimited range, piercing all allied and enemy Heroes in its path. Allies are healed for 225 (+4% per level) and enemies are damaged for 135 (+4% per level). Deals 50% less damage to Structures.

abilities.name: Leap of Faith
abilities.description:
Faith instantly pulls an allied Hero to Anduin's location, granting them Unstoppable while they travel.

Pursued By Grace

Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes heal the lowest Health allied Hero near Anduin for 32 (+4% per level).

abilities.name: Flash Heal
abilities.description: Cast for 0.75 seconds to heal an allied Hero for 280 (+4% per level).

abilities.name: Divine Star
abilities.description: Send light that deals 140 (+4% per level) damage to enemies and then returns to Anduin, healing allied Heroes for 130 (+4% per level) in a wider path. Healing increases by 25% per enemy Hero hit.

abilities.name: Chastise
abilities.description: Shove a swell of light forward, dealing 175 (+4% per level) damage to the first enemy Hero hit and Rooting them for 1.25 seconds.

abilities.name: Holy Word: Salvation
abilities.description: After 0.5 seconds, Channel to invoke the Light for 3 seconds. While nearby, allied Heroes heal for up to 30% of their max Health and are Protected.

abilities.name: Lightbomb
abilities.description:
Imbue an allied Hero with the Light. After 1.5 seconds, it explodes, dealing 150 (+4% per level) damage to enemies and Stunning them for 1.25 seconds.

The target gains a Shield that absorbs 165 (+4% per level) damage per enemy Hero hit. Lasts for 5 seconds.

abilities.name: Soothing Mist
abilities.description:
Activate to remove all Stun, Root, Slow, and Silence effects from nearby allied Heroes.

Passive: Brightwing heals nearby allied Heroes for 110 (+4% per level) every 4 seconds

abilities.name: Arcane Flare
abilities.description: Shoot a flare dealing 75 (+4% per level) damage to enemies hit, and an additional 105 (+4% per level) damage to enemies in the center. If a Hero is hit by the center, Soothing Mist's passive healing instantly activates.

abilities.name: Polymorph
abilities.description: Polymorph a target for 1.5 seconds, Slowing their Movement Speed by 30% and Silencing them. Targets are not able to attack while Polymorphed.

abilities.name: Pixie Dust
abilities.description: Increase target Hero's Movement Speed by 20%, and grant them 30 Spell Armor for 3 seconds, reducing Spell damage taken by 30%.

abilities.name: Blink Heal
abilities.description:
Teleport to a nearby ally. When teleporting to a Hero, heal them for 200 (+4% per level).

Stores up to 2 charges.

abilities.name: Emerald Wind
abilities.description: After 0.5 seconds, create an expanding nova of wind, dealing 225 (+4% per level) damage and pushing enemies away.

abilities.name: Phase Shift
abilities.description: After 2 seconds, teleport to an allied Hero and heal them for 25% of their maximum Health.

abilities.name: Blink Heal - Double Wyrmhole
abilities.description: Teleport to a nearby ally, healing them for 200 (+4% per level).

abilities.name: Bestow Hope
abilities.description:
Passive: 70% of the damage Auriel deals to Heroes and 35% dealt to non-Heroes is stored as energy.

Bestow an allied Hero with Hope. While they remain near Auriel, 30% of their damage to Heroes and 10% of their damage to non-Heroes is converted to energy. Auriel can only have Bestow Hope on 1 ally at a time.

Auriel can store up to 475 (+4% per level) energy.

abilities.name: Sacred Sweep
abilities.description: Sweep the area with sacred power, dealing 40 (+4% per level) damage to enemies and an additional 160 (+4% per level) damage to enemies caught in the center.

abilities.name: Ray of Heaven
abilities.description: Consume Auriel's stored energy and heal allied Heroes in the area for the amount of energy consumed.

abilities.name: Detainment Strike
abilities.description: Deal 55 (+4% per level) damage to the first enemy Hero hit and knock them back. If they collide with terrain, they are also stunned for 1.25 seconds and take an additional 165 (+4% per level) damage.

abilities.name: Resurrect
abilities.description:
Channel on the spirit of a dead ally for 1 second. After a 3 second delay, they are brought back to life with 100% of their maximum Health at the location where they died.

Auriel can use this ability while dead to resurrect herself.

abilities.name: Crystal Aegis
abilities.description: Place an allied Hero into Stasis for 2 seconds. Upon expiration, Crystal Aegis deals 255 (+4% per level) damage to all nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Fortitude of the Faithful
abilities.description: When at least 1 other allied Hero is nearby, Deckard gains 10 Armor and his Basic Abilities recharge 50% faster.

abilities.name: Healing Potion
abilities.description:
Throw a Healing Potion on the ground that heals the first allied Hero that comes in contact with it for 285 (+4% per level).

Limit 5 active Potions.

abilities.name: Horadric Cube
abilities.description: Release the Horadric Cube. After 0.5 seconds it explodes, dealing 80 (+4% per level) damage to all enemies in the area and Slowing them by 35% for 2 seconds.

abilities.name: Scroll Of Sealing
abilities.description: Unfurl an enchanted scroll over 2.25 seconds, forming a triangle that deals 150 (+4% per level) damage to enemies inside and Roots them for 1.5 seconds.

abilities.name: Stay Awhile and Listen
abilities.description:
After 1 second, Channel for 3 seconds, putting enemy Heroes in front of Deckard to Sleep while Channeling, and for 2 seconds after.

Enemies can only be put to Sleep once per cast, and Sleep's effects end instantly if they take damage.

abilities.name: Lorenado
abilities.description:
Vector Targeting
After 1 second, create a twirling tome tornado that travels towards the targeted direction, continually knocking away enemies that come into contact with it. Deals 20 (+4% per level) damage to Heroes hit.

abilities.name: Pick Your Trait
abilities.description: Choose between Transcendence, Iron Fists, and Insight from the Talents panel.

abilities.name: Radiant Dash
abilities.description:
Jump to an allied or enemy unit. Enemies are immediately hit with a Basic Attack.

Stores up to 2 charges.

abilities.name: Breath of Heaven
abilities.description: Heal nearby Heroes for 295 (+4% per level) and give them 15% Movement Speed for 3 seconds.

abilities.name: Deadly Reach
abilities.description: Kharazim's next Basic Attack increases his Attack Speed and Attack Range by 100% for 2 seconds.

abilities.name: Seven-Sided Strike
abilities.description: Become Invulnerable and strike 7 times over 2 seconds. Each strike hits the highest Health nearby Hero for 7% of their maximum Health.

abilities.name: Divine Palm
abilities.description: Protect an allied Hero from death, causing them to be healed for 1200 (+4% per level) if they take fatal damage in the next 4 seconds.

abilities.name: Fast Feet
abilities.description: Upon taking damage, your Basic Ability cooldowns refresh 50% faster and you gain 10% Movement Speed for 1 second.

abilities.name: Healing Brew
abilities.description: Heal the lowest Health allied Hero within 6 range for 210 (+4% per level) Health.

abilities.name: Cloud Serpent
abilities.description: Summon a Cloud Serpent on an allied Hero that attacks nearby enemies every second. Each attack deals 26 (+4% per level) damage and heals the ally for 20 (+4% per level). Lasts for 8 seconds.

abilities.name: Blinding Wind
abilities.description: Throw a cloud of wind at the 2 nearest enemies (prioritizing Heroes), dealing 133 (+4% per level) damage. Heroes hit are Blinded and Slowed by 15% for 1.5 seconds.

abilities.name: Jug of 1,000 Cups
abilities.description: Channel for up to 6 seconds. Every 0.25 seconds, increase the cooldown of Jug of 1,000 Cups by 2 seconds, up to 50 additional seconds, and heal the lowest Health nearby allied Hero for 75 (+4% per level) Health.

abilities.name: Water Dragon
abilities.description: Li Li channels for 2 seconds, summoning a Water Dragon that hits the nearest enemy Hero within 12 range and all enemies near them, dealing 300 (+4% per level) damage and slowing their Movement Speed by 70% for 4 seconds.

abilities.name: Caduceus Reactor
abilities.description: While channeling Healing Beam, Lt. Morales regenerates 2% of her maximum Health per second.

abilities.name: Healing Beam
abilities.description:
Heal target allied Hero or Minion for 172 (+4% per level) Health per second as long as they are in range. After not channeling Healing Beam for 2 seconds, regenerate 6 Energy per second.

Reactivate to switch targets, or self-cast to cancel channeling.

abilities.name: Safeguard
abilities.description: Grant target ally Hero 35 Armor for 3 seconds.

abilities.name: Displacement Grenade
abilities.description: Fire a grenade that can be manually detonated, dealing 208 (+4% per level) to nearby enemies and knocking them away.

abilities.name: Stim Drone
abilities.description: Grant an allied Hero 75% Attack Speed and 25% Movement Speed for 10 seconds.

abilities.name: Medivac Dropship
abilities.description: Target a location for a Medivac transport. For up to 10 seconds before takeoff, allies can right-click to enter the Medivac.

abilities.name: Displacement Grenade - Detonate Displacement Grenade
abilities.description: Detonate Displacement Grenade, dealing 208 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies and knocking them away.

abilities.name: Medivac Dropship - Depart
abilities.description: Departs for the targeted location immediately.

abilities.name: Push Off
abilities.description: While moving alongside terrain, activate to slide towards a targeted location. Enemies hit take 100 (+4% per level) damage and are Slowed by 75% for 1 second.

abilities.name: Soundwave
abilities.description: Deal 105 (+4% per level) damage to enemies in an area and knock them back.

abilities.name: Crossfade
abilities.description:
Currently playing Speed Boost, increasing the Movement Speed of Lúcio and nearby allied Heroes by 10%.

Toggle to play Healing Boost instead.

abilities.name: Amp It Up
abilities.description: Raise Lúcio's Crossfade track volume for 3 seconds, amping Healing Boost to 112 (+4% per level) Health per second and Speed Boost to 30% increased Movement Speed.

abilities.name: Sound Barrier
abilities.description: After 1 second, Lúcio and nearby allied Heroes gain a 1296 (+4% per level) point Shield that rapidly decays over 6 seconds.

abilities.name: High Five
abilities.description: Quickly skate to an allied Hero. Upon arrival the ally is healed for 230 (+4% per level), Lúcio is healed for 80 (+4% per level), and both gain Unstoppable for 1 second.

abilities.name: Wall Ride
abilities.description: When moving alongside terrain, Lúcio begins to Wall Ride for 2 seconds. While Wall Ride is active, Lúcio can walk through units and gains 20% Movement Speed that stacks with other bonuses.

abilities.name: Innervate
abilities.description:
Grant an allied Hero 20% of their maximum Mana over 5 seconds. While affected by Innervate, their Basic Ability cooldowns recharge 50% faster.

Cannot be used on Heroes that do not use Mana.

abilities.name: Regrowth
abilities.description: Heal an allied Hero for 380 (+4% per level) Health over 20 seconds.

abilities.name: Moonfire
abilities.description:
Deal 90 (+4% per level) damage to enemies in an area and reveal them for 2 seconds.

Allies with an active Regrowth are healed for 130 (+4% per level) Health for each enemy Hero hit by Moonfire.

abilities.name: Entangling Roots
abilities.description: Root enemy Heroes in an area for 1.25 seconds, and deal 117 (+4% per level) damage over the duration. Affected area grows over 3 seconds.

abilities.name: Tranquility
abilities.description: Heal nearby allied Heroes for 80 (+4% per level) Health per second for 8 seconds. Allies affected by Regrowth within Tranquility's area gain 10 Armor.

abilities.name: Twilight Dream
abilities.description: After 0.5 seconds, deal 310 (+4% per level) damage in a large area around Malfurion, Silencing enemies making them unable to use Abilities for 3 seconds.

abilities.name: Purge
abilities.description:
When used on an allied Hero, make them Unstoppable for 0.5 seconds. When used on an enemy Hero, Slow them by 80%, decaying over 2 seconds.

Cannot be cast on yourself.

abilities.name: Chain Heal
abilities.description: Heal an ally with a wave of healing for 260 (+4% per level) Health. The wave then bounces 2 times to nearby allies within 7 range, restoring 260 (+4% per level) Health to them.

abilities.name: Lightning Shield
abilities.description: Imbue an ally with lightning dealing 64 (+4% per level) damage a second to nearby enemies. Each enemy hit restores 1 Mana to Rehgar. Lasts 5 seconds.

abilities.name: Earthbind Totem
abilities.description: Create a totem that Slows nearby enemies by 35%. The totem has 260 (+4% per level) Health and lasts for 6 seconds.

abilities.name: Bloodlust
abilities.description: Grant nearby allied Heroes 40% Attack Speed and 35% Movement Speed and causes them to heal for 30% of the Basic Attack damage to their primary target. Lasts for 6 seconds.

abilities.name: Ancestral Healing
abilities.description: After 1 second, heal an allied Hero for 1180 (+4% per level) Health.

abilities.name: Ghost Wolf
abilities.description: Instead of using a mount, Rehgar transforms into a Ghost Wolf with 20% increased Movement Speed. Basic Attacks in Ghost Wolf form cause him to lunge at his target and deal 60% bonus damage. Dealing damage, using Abilities, and channeling cancels Ghost Wolf form.

abilities.name: Earthbind Totem - Totemic Projection
abilities.description: Instantly move Earthbind Totem to a new location.

abilities.name: Bio-Kill Switch
abilities.description:
Activate to detonate all of Stukov's Viruses. Each Healing Pathogen heals its target for 435 (+4% per level) Health, and each Weighted Pustule does 100 (+4% per level) damage and Slows its target by 70% for 2 seconds.

Can be cast while Channeling Lurking Arm.

abilities.name: Healing Pathogen
abilities.description:
Infest an allied Hero with a Healing Pathogen that heals the target for 222 (+4% per level) Health over 4.5 seconds. Healing Pathogens can spread to a nearby allied Hero every 0.75 seconds.

Each cast of Healing Pathogen can only spread to each allied Hero 1 time.

abilities.name: Weighted Pustule
abilities.description: Hurl a pustule that impacts all enemy Heroes in its path, dealing 20 (+4% per level) damage and Slowing by 5%, increasing to 50% over 3 seconds. Deals an additional 88 (+4% per level) damage upon expiring or being removed.

abilities.name: Lurking Arm
abilities.description:
Channel at a target location, creating an area that deals 136 (+4% per level) damage per second to non-Structure enemies and Silences them. Deals 50% reduced damage to non-Heroes.

Does not cost Mana while Channeling, and lasts until canceled or interrupted.

abilities.name: Massive Shove
abilities.description: Extend Stukov's arm. If it hits an enemy Hero, they are rapidly shoved until they collide with terrain, dealing 190 (+4% per level) damage and Stunning them for 0.5 seconds. Stukov gains 50 Armor while shoving an enemy.

abilities.name: Flailing Swipe
abilities.description: Swipe 3 times in front of Stukov over 1.75 seconds, dealing 48 (+4% per level) damage to enemies hit and knocking them away. Each swipe is larger than the previous.

abilities.name: Hunter's Mark
abilities.description:
Reveal a non-Structure enemy and reduce their Armor by 15 for 4 seconds.

Passive: Tyrande's Basic Attacks heal her for 1% of her maximum Health, doubled against targets with Hunter's Mark.

abilities.name: Light of Elune
abilities.description:
Heal an ally Hero for 270 (+4% per level). Light of Elune's cooldown is reduced by 1.5 seconds every time Tyrande hits an enemy with a Basic Attack or damages an enemy Hero.

Stores up to 2 charges. Cooldown replenishes all charges at the same time.

abilities.name: Sentinel
abilities.description: Send an Owl across the battleground revealing its path, dealing 120 (+4% per level) damage to the first Hero hit, and revealing them for 5 seconds. If a Hero revealed by Sentinel dies, refresh its cooldown.

abilities.name: Lunar Flare
abilities.description:
After 0.75 seconds, deal 150 (+4% per level) damage and Stun enemies in the target area for 0.75 seconds. Restores 25 Mana per enemy hit.

Quest: Hitting a Hero with Lunar Flare increases its damage by 3%, up to 120%. Double this bonus if the Hero dies within 3 seconds.

Reward: After hitting 10 Heroes, increase Lunar Flare's range by 30%.

Reward: After hitting 20 Heroes, Sentinel now pierces the first Hero hit.

Mythic Reward: After hitting 40 Heroes, Every 8th Basic Attacks fires a Lunar Flare, prioritizing Heroes. Attack Range increased by 1.

abilities.name: Shadowstalk
abilities.description: Grant all allied Heroes Stealth for 10 seconds and heal them for 380 (+4% per level) Health over 10 seconds. Remaining stationary for at least 1.5 seconds while Stealthed grants Invisible.

abilities.name: Starfall
abilities.description: Deal 92 (+4% per level) damage per second and Slow enemies by 20% in an area. Lasts 6 seconds.

abilities.name: Devotion
abilities.description:
Uther's Basic Abilities grant 25 Armor to allied Heroes, and 15 to Uther, for 2 seconds.

Eternal Vanguard

Upon dying, Uther becomes an Invulnerable spirit for up to 8 seconds. While in spirit form, Uther can heal allies with Flash of Light for 230 (+4% per level).

abilities.name: Holy Light
abilities.description: Heal target allied Hero for 362 (+4% per level) Health. When used on a target other than Uther, also heal Uther for 181 (+4% per level) Health.

abilities.name: Holy Radiance
abilities.description: Heal all allied Heroes and Minions in a line for 194 (+4% per level) Health, dealing 177 (+4% per level) damage to enemies.

abilities.name: Hammer of Justice
abilities.description: Deal 109 (+4% per level) damage and Stun the target for 1 second.

abilities.name: Divine Shield
abilities.description: Make an allied Hero Invulnerable and increase their Movement Speed by 20% for 3 seconds.

abilities.name: Divine Storm
abilities.description: Deal 170 (+4% per level) damage and Stun nearby enemies for 1.75 seconds.

abilities.name: Devotion - Flash of Light
abilities.description: Heal an ally for 230 (+4% per level) Health.

abilities.name: Zeal
abilities.description:
Whitemane's healing Abilities apply Zeal for 8 seconds. Allies with Zeal are healed for 100% of the damage Whitemane deals to Heroes.

Activate to gain 25% Spell Power and lose 15 Armor for 5 seconds. Can be cast while channeling abilities.

abilities.name: Desperate Plea
abilities.description:
Heal an allied Hero for 140 (+4% per level) and gain Desperation for 4 seconds.

Desperation increases Desperate Plea's Mana cost by 40, and stacks up to 3 times.

Current Mana Cost: 40

abilities.name: Inquisition
abilities.description:
Channel on an enemy Hero for up to 3 seconds, dealing 50 (+4% per level) damage every 0.5 seconds and Slowing them by 30%. Removes a stack of Desperation.

Shares a cooldown with Clemency.

abilities.name: Searing Lash
abilities.description:
After 0.5 seconds, smite enemies in a straight line for 82 (+4% per level) damage.

If the first strike hits an enemy Hero, a second strike will occur after a short delay.

Repeatable Quest: Hit Heroes with Searing Lash.
Repeatable Quest: Hit 3 Heroes with Basic Attacks.

Reward: Permanently increase Whitemane's maximum Health by 3 and Mana by 2. Heroes hit with the second strike of Searing Lash count as 2 hits.

abilities.name: Scarlet Aegis
abilities.description: Bolster the spirits of nearby allied Heroes, healing them for 300 (+4% per level) and granting them 40 Armor for 4 seconds.

abilities.name: Divine Reckoning
abilities.description: After 1 second, consecrate an area for 4 seconds, dealing 50 (+4% per level) damage every 0.5 seconds to enemies inside. 25% of the damage dealt to Heroes is returned as Mana.

abilities.name: Clemency
abilities.description:
Activate to cast Inquisition on an allied Hero, healing them for up to 329 (+4% per level) over 3 seconds while Channeling. Removes a stack of Desperation

Shares a cooldown with Inquisition.

abilities.name: Sadism
abilities.description:
Alarak's Ability damage and self-healing are increased by 100% against enemy Heroes.

Repeatable Quest: Takedowns increase Sadism by 3%, up to 30%. Sadism gained from Takedowns is lost on death.

abilities.name: Discord Strike
abilities.description: After a 0.5 second delay, enemies in front of Alarak take 165 (+4% per level) damage and are silenced for 1.5 seconds.

abilities.name: Telekinesis
abilities.description:
Vector Targeting
Create a force, pushing Alarak and all enemies hit from the targeted point towards the targeted direction. Deals 48 (+4% per level) damage to enemies.

abilities.name: Lightning Surge
abilities.description: Deal 62 (+4% per level) damage to an enemy and an additional 100% damage to enemies between Alarak and the target. Restore 75 (+4% per level) health for each Hero hit.

abilities.name: Deadly Charge
abilities.description:
After channeling, Alarak charges forward dealing 200 (+4% per level) damage to all enemies in his path. Distance is increased based on the amount of time channeled, up to 1.5 seconds.

Issuing a Move order while this is channeling will cancel it at no cost. Taking damage will interrupt the channeling.

abilities.name: Counter-Strike
abilities.description: Alarak targets an area and channels for 1 second, becoming Protected and Unstoppable. After, if he took damage from an enemy Hero, he sends a shockwave that deals 275 (+4% per level) damage.

abilities.name: Deadly Charge - Unleash Deadly Charge
abilities.description:
Unleash Alarak's Deadly Charge.

Issuing a move order while this is channeling will cancel the cast at no cost. Taking damage will interrupt the channeling.

abilities.name: Fresh Meat
abilities.description:
Upon dying, nearby enemy Minions drop 1 Fresh Meat and enemy Heroes drop 20 Fresh Meat. Fresh Meat can be picked up to gain 0.5 Attack Damage per Meat. The Butcher loses 15 Fresh Meat upon dying.

Quest: Collect 200 Fresh Meat.

Reward: Gain an additional 125 Attack Damage and 25% increased Attack Speed. Heroes continue to drop 10 Fresh Meat, Minions no longer drop Fresh Meat, and Fresh Meat is no longer lost on death.

abilities.name: Hamstring
abilities.description: Deal 110 (+4% per level) damage and Slow enemies by 50%, decaying over 2 seconds. The Butcher's next Basic Attack will strike immediately.

abilities.name: Butcher's Brand
abilities.description:
Deal 37 (+4% per level) damage to an enemy and Brand them for 4 seconds. The Butcher's Basic Attacks against the Branded target heal him for 75% of the damage done.

Basic Attacks against Branded Heroes heal for double and extend the duration of the Brand by 0.5 seconds.

abilities.name: Ruthless Onslaught
abilities.description: Charge at an enemy, becoming Unstoppable and gaining Movement Speed. If The Butcher reaches the target, they are stunned for 1 second and take 119 (+4% per level) damage.

abilities.name: Furnace Blast
abilities.description:
After a 3 second delay, fire explodes around The Butcher dealing 500 (+4% per level) damage to enemies.

Can be cast while using Ruthless Onslaught.

abilities.name: Lamb to the Slaughter
abilities.description: Throw a hitching post that attaches to the nearest enemy Hero after a 1 second delay. This deals 171 (+4% per level) damage and causes the enemy to be chained to the post and Silenced for 3 seconds.

abilities.name: Betrayer's Thirst
abilities.description: Basic Attacks heal for 30% of damage dealt and reduce Ability cooldowns by 1 second.

abilities.name: Dive
abilities.description: Dive at the target, dealing 66 (+4% per level) damage and flipping to the other side of the target.

abilities.name: Sweeping Strike
abilities.description: Dash towards target point, dealing 119 (+4% per level) damage to enemies along the way. Hitting an enemy increases Illidan's Basic Attack damage by 35% for 3 seconds.

abilities.name: Evasion
abilities.description: Evade enemy Basic Attacks for 2.5 seconds.

abilities.name: The Hunt
abilities.description: Charge to target unit, dealing 251 (+4% per level) damage on impact and stunning for 1 second.

abilities.name: Metamorphosis
abilities.description: Transform into Demon Form at the target location, dealing 46 (+4% per level) damage in the area. Temporarily increases maximum Health by 220 (+4% per level) for each Hero hit by the initial impact. Lasts for 18 seconds.

abilities.name: Assimilation
abilities.description:
Gain 10% of damage dealt from Abilities and 20% from Basic Attacks as Shields for 6 seconds. Shield amount gained doubled against Heroes.

Current maximum: 1004 (+4% per level)

abilities.name: Ravage
abilities.description:
Leap to a target, dealing 115 (+4% per level) damage. If the enemy dies within 0.75 seconds, restore 1 charge and refund 20 Mana.

Quest: Kill enemies within a short distance of Kerrigan. Minions grant 1 stack and Heroes grant 7 stacks. 

Reward: After reaching 100 stacks, Ravage deals 125 additional damage and Hero kills now provide 14 stacks.

Mythic Reward: After reaching a 250 stacks, Ravage deals a further 200 additional damage.

abilities.name: Impaling Blades
abilities.description: After 1.25 seconds, deal 150 (+4% per level) damage to enemies within the target area, Stunning them for 0.75 seconds.

abilities.name: Primal Grasp
abilities.description: Pulls enemies within the target area towards Kerrigan, dealing 40 (+4% per level) damage. After 2.5 seconds, an explosion occurs around Kerrigan, dealing 160 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Summon Ultralisk
abilities.description:
After 0.5 seconds, summon an Ultralisk that rushes forward upon spawning, dealing 225 (+4% per level) damage to the first enemy Hero hit and Stunning them for 0.5 seconds.

The Ultralisk's Basic Attacks deal 50% of their damage in an area around their target. Reactivate to retarget the Ultralisk.

abilities.name: Maelstrom
abilities.description: Deals 74 (+4% per level) damage per second to nearby enemies. Lasts for 7 seconds.

abilities.name: Vault of the Wardens
abilities.description:
Leap into the air, becoming Immune to all hostile effects for 0.75 seconds.

After reaching Level 20, Vault of the Wardens gains an additional charge.

abilities.name: Fan of Knives
abilities.description:
Deal 152 (+4% per level) damage to enemies in a crescent area.

Hitting at least 2 enemy Heroes with Fan of Knives reduces its cooldown to 0.5 seconds, and refunds its Mana cost.

abilities.name: Umbral Bind
abilities.description: Maiev's next Basic Attack cleaves and applies a tether to enemy Heroes hit for 2.5 seconds. If a tethered Hero moves too far from Maiev, they are pulled toward her, dealing 110 (+4% per level) damage and breaking the tether.

abilities.name: Spirit of Vengeance
abilities.description: Send a shadow of Maiev outward that will return to its cast location, dealing 150 (+4% per level) damage to enemies along both paths. If an enemy Hero is hit, reduce the cooldown by 4 seconds.

abilities.name: Containment Disc
abilities.description:
Throw a glaive in the target direction. If an enemy Hero is hit, Containment Disc can be reactivated to remove their vision and Time Stop them for 4 seconds. Leaving Containment Silences the enemy Hero for 1.5 seconds.

Containment Disc automatically activates 6 seconds after hitting a Hero.

abilities.name: Warden's Cage
abilities.description: Summon 8 Warden Avatars as a cage around Maiev. After 1.5 seconds, enemy Heroes that come in contact with an Avatar consume it and are knocked to the center of the cage. Warden Avatars last 5 seconds.

abilities.name: Spirit of Vengeance - Blink
abilities.description: Teleport to the Spirit of Vengeance, consuming it.

abilities.name: Containment Disc - Contain
abilities.description: Activate to remove the target's vision and Time Stop them for 4 seconds.

abilities.name: Grappling Hook
abilities.description:
Qhira fires a grappling hook that pulls her to terrain it contacts. If an enemy Hero is hit, they take 35 (+4% per level) damage and Qhira launches at them, kicking them for an additional 108 (+4% per level) damage.

Can be used while Revolving Sweep is active.

abilities.name: Carnage
abilities.description: Unleash your sword in the target direction, continuously dealing 30 (+4% per level) damage to enemies caught in its path.

abilities.name: Blood Rage
abilities.description:
Qhira deals 32 (+4% per level) damage and heals for 90 (+4% per level) Health per enemy Hero affected. Damage and healing is increased by 50% per each additional stack on that Hero.

Passive: Basic Attack and Ability damage cause enemies to bleed for 32 (+4% per level) damage over 4 seconds. Stacks 5 times.

Quest: Damage enemy Heroes with Blood Rage's bleed damage to permanently increase its damage by 0.24%. 

Reward: After damaging Heroes with Blood Rage's bleed damage 150 times, Blood Rage's duration is increased by 2 seconds.

abilities.name: Revolving Sweep
abilities.description:
Attach your sword on the first enemy Hero hit, dealing 96 (+4% per level) damage and Stunning them for 0.25 seconds. Once attached, Qhira becomes Immune to all effects, swinging around the target for 2.75 seconds and dealing 105 (+4% per level) damage to enemies between you and the target.

Re-activate to send you to the target's location knocking them away, dealing 108 (+4% per level) damage and Stunning them for 0.75 seconds.

abilities.name: Unrelenting Strikes
abilities.description: Deal 44 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies every 0.5 seconds for 2.5 seconds as your sword grows outward. Upon expiring, deal 160 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemy Heroes and Stun them for 1.5 seconds.

abilities.name: Final Strike
abilities.description: After 1 second, deal 410 (+4% per level) damage to enemies in a line. This damage is increased by 25% against enemy Heroes who are below 50% Health.

abilities.name: Spawn Egg
abilities.description:
Place an Egg at target location, revealing the nearby area. Upon dying, Murky respawns at the Egg after 8 seconds. Murky only grants 25% of a real Hero's experience upon dying.

If Murky's Egg is killed, he is revealed to enemies for 15 seconds, and Spawn Egg is placed on cooldown.

abilities.name: Slime
abilities.description:
Deal 86 (+4% per level) damage and apply Slime on nearby enemies for 6 seconds, Slowing them by 20%. 

Deal 210 (+4% per level) damage to enemies who are already Slimed. Structures take 50% damage.

abilities.name: Pufferfish
abilities.description:
Spit out a Pufferfish with 225 (+5.5% per level) health at the target point. After 2.75 seconds, the fish will blow up for 330 (+4% per level) damage. Deals 50% less damage to Structures.

Quest: Kill Slimed Enemies or hit them with Pufferfish. Heroes and Structures award 4 bonus stacks.

Reward: After obtaining 200 stacks, Murky's Basic Abilities no longer deal reduced damage to structures.

Mythic Reward: After obtaining 400 stacks, Murky's health is increased by 50%.

abilities.name: Safety Bubble
abilities.description: Becomes Invulnerable for 2 seconds. While active, Murky cannot attack or use abilities.

abilities.name: March of the Murlocs
abilities.description: After 0.75 seconds, Murky commands a legion of Murlocs to march in a target direction, each one leaping onto the first enemy Hero or Structure they find. Each Murloc deals 130 (+4% per level) damage and slows its target by 15% for 5 seconds. Murlocs deal 50% damage to Structures.

abilities.name: Octo-Grab
abilities.description: Murky becomes Unstoppable and Stuns target enemy Hero for 3 seconds while he hits them for 1 damage a second.

abilities.name: Image Transmission
abilities.description:
Activate to switch places with a target Mirror Image, removing most negative effects from Samuro and all Mirror Images.

Advancing Strikes

Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes increase Samuro's Movement Speed by 25% for 2 seconds.

abilities.name: Mirror Image
abilities.description:
Teleport a short distance in the direction of the mouse cursor, creating 2 Mirror Image in the opposite direction with as much Health as Samuro, each dealing 11 (+4% per level) damage with their Basic Attacks. Whenever an Image takes damage, it deals that amount of damage to itself, effectively doubling the damage it takes.

Mirror Images last for 8 seconds, and up to 2 Mirror Images can be active at a time. Each time they or Samuro hit an enemy Hero with their Basic Attack, their duration is extended by 1 second. Using Mirror Image removes most negative effects from Samuro.

abilities.name: Critical Strike
abilities.description:
Activate to cause Samuro and his Mirror Images next Basic Attack within 8 seconds to be a Critical Strike, dealing 50% additional damage. Stealth is not broken when activated.

Passive: Samuro and his Images also deal a Critical Strike every 4th Basic Attack.

abilities.name: Wind Walk
abilities.description:
Grant Samuro Stealth for up to 10 seconds or until he attacks, uses an Ability, or takes damage.

While Stealthed, Samuro heals for 2% of his maximum Health every second, his Movement Speed is increased by 20% and he can pass through other units. Remaining stationary for at least 1.5 seconds while Stealthed grants Invisible.

Samuro is Unrevealable for the first 1 second of Wind Walk.

abilities.name: Bladestorm
abilities.description: Cause a Bladestorm of destructive force around Samuro for 3 seconds, granting him 25 Armor and dealing 180 (+4% per level) damage per second to nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Illusion Master
abilities.description:
Mirror Images can be controlled individually or as a group and their damage is increased by 100%. 

Passive: Image Transmission's cooldown is reduced to 8 seconds.

abilities.name: Select Samuro
abilities.description:
Select Samuro

Issue orders to Samuro only.

abilities.name: Select All
abilities.description:
Select All

Issue orders to Samuro and all Mirror Images.

abilities.name: Vanish
abilities.description:
Vanish from sight, becoming Stealthed, gaining 20% Movement Speed and access to new Abilities. For the first second, Valeera is Unrevealable and can pass through other units. Remaining stationary for at least 1.5 seconds while Stealthed grants Invisible.

After being Stealthed for 3 seconds, the cast range of Ambush, Cheap Shot, and Garrote is increased from 2.5 to 5, and they cause Valeera to teleport to the target when used.

abilities.name: Sinister Strike
abilities.description:
Dash forward, hitting all enemies in a line for 110 (+4% per level) damage. If Sinister Strike hits a Hero, Valeera stops dashing immediately and the cooldown is reduced to 1 second.

Awards 1 Combo Point.

Stealth: Ambush
Heavily damage an enemy and reduce their Armor.

abilities.name: Blade Flurry
abilities.description:
Deal 130 (+4% per level) damage in an area around Valeera. 

Awards 1 Combo Point per enemy Hero hit.

Stealth: Cheap Shot
Stun, Blind, and damage an enemy.

abilities.name: Eviscerate
abilities.description:
Eviscerate an enemy, dealing damage per Combo Point. 

1 Point: 85 (+4% per level)
2 Points: 170 (+4% per level)
3 Points: 255 (+4% per level)

Stealth: Garrote
Silence and damage an enemy over time.

abilities.name: Cloak of Shadows
abilities.description:
Valeera is enveloped in a Cloak of Shadows, which immediately removes all damage over time effects from her. For 1.5 seconds, she becomes Unstoppable and gains 75 Spell Armor, reducing Ability Damage taken by 75%.

Using this Ability does not break Stealth.

abilities.name: Smoke Bomb
abilities.description:
Create a cloud of smoke. While in the smoke, Valeera is Unrevealable, can pass through other units, and gains 60 Armor, reducing damage taken by 60%. Valeera can continue to attack and use abilities without being revealed. Lasts 5 seconds.

Using this Ability does not break Stealth.

abilities.name: Vanish - Ambush
abilities.description:
Ambush an enemy, dealing 130 (+4% per level) damage and reducing their Armor by 10 for 5 seconds.

Awards 1 Combo Point.

Unstealth: Sinister Strike
Dash forward, damaging enemies.

abilities.name: Vanish - Cheap Shot
abilities.description:
Deal 30 (+4% per level) damage to an enemy, Stun them for 0.75 seconds, and Blind them for 2 seconds once Cheap Shot's Stun expires.

Awards 1 Combo Point.

Unstealth: Blade Flurry
Deal damage in an area around Valeera.

abilities.name: Vanish - Garrote
abilities.description:
Deal 20 (+4% per level) damage to an enemy and an additional 140 (+4% per level) damage over 7 seconds, and Silence them for 2.5 seconds.

Awards 1 Combo Point.

Unstealth: Eviscerate
High damage finishing move.

abilities.name: Permanent Cloak
abilities.description: Gain Stealth when out of combat for 3 seconds. Taking damage, attacking, using Abilities, or Channeling ends Stealth. Remaining stationary for at least 1.5 seconds while Stealthed grants Invisible.

abilities.name: Cleave
abilities.description: Deal 200 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Singularity Spike
abilities.description: Flings a Singularity Spike that sticks to the first enemy hit. Deals 240 (+4% per level) damage after 1 second and Slows the enemy by 40% for 3 seconds.

abilities.name: Blink
abilities.description:
Teleport to the target location.

Using this Ability does not break Stealth.

abilities.name: Might Of The Nerazim
abilities.description:
Activate to cast an untalented version of Zeratul's most recently used Basic Ability, dealing 50% less damage.

Passive: After using an Ability, Zeratul's next Basic Attack within 6 seconds deals 30% more damage.

abilities.name: Void Prison
abilities.description: Slows time in an area to a near standstill, placing allies and enemies in Time Stop for 5 seconds. Zeratul is not affected.

abilities.name: Vorpal Blade
abilities.description: Activate to teleport to Zeratul's last non-structure Basic Attack target within 3 seconds. The target is revealed during these 3 seconds.

abilities.name: Avoidance
abilities.description:
While moving, Cassia gradually gains up to 30 Armor over 3 seconds. After being stationary for 0.75 seconds, the Armor is rapidly lost over .5 seconds. 

Avoidance remains charged while Fending.

abilities.name: Lightning Fury
abilities.description: Hurl a lightning javelin that deals 158 (+4% per level) damage to the first enemy hit and splits into two lightning bolts that deal 158 (+4% per level) damage to enemies in their path.

abilities.name: Blinding Light
abilities.description:
After 0.5 seconds, deal 50 (+4% per level) damage and Blind enemies in the target area for 2 seconds.

Passive: Cassia deals 15% increased damage to Blinded targets.

abilities.name: Fend
abilities.description: Charge at an enemy, and upon arriving Channel for up to 1.5 seconds, dealing 64 (+4% per level) damage to enemies in front of Cassia every 0.25 seconds. Deals 50% reduced damage to non-Heroes. Avoidance remains charged while Channeling.

abilities.name: Ball Lightning
abilities.description: Throw a ball of lightning at an enemy Hero that bounces up to 6 times between nearby enemy Heroes and Cassia, dealing 180 (+4% per level) damage to enemies hit.

abilities.name: Valkyrie
abilities.description: Summon a Valkyrie that rushes to Cassia after 0.75 seconds, pulling the first enemy Hero hit, dealing 225 (+4% per level) damage and Stunning them for 0.5 seconds at the end of her path. The Valkyrie knocks back all other enemy Heroes in her way.

abilities.name: Timewalker
abilities.description:
Chromie has traveled to the future, and as such, will learn her Talents 2 levels earlier than her teammates!

Detonate Time Trap

Detonates active Time Traps.

abilities.name: Sand Blast
abilities.description:
After 0.5 seconds, fire a missile that deals 305 (+4% per level) damage to the first enemy hit. Deals 50% damage to Structures.

Casting Sand Blast leaves an Echo behind that mimics Chromie's Sand Blast and Basic Attack, dealing 40% damage. Maximum of 1 Echo active at a time.

abilities.name: Dragon’s Breath
abilities.description:
Vector Targeting
Launch 3 blasts into the air that land every 0.75 seconds towards the targeted direction, dealing 215 (+4% per level) damage each.

abilities.name: Time Trap
abilities.description: Place a Time Trap that arms and Stealths after 2 seconds. Chromie's Trait can be activated to detonate the trap, placing all nearby allied or enemy Heroes in Time Stop for 2 seconds. Maximum of 1 trap active at a time.

abilities.name: Temporal Loop
abilities.description:
Choose an enemy Hero. After 3 seconds, they are teleported back to the location where Temporal Loop was cast on them.

Basic Abilities recharge 500% faster for 3 seconds after casting Temporal Loop.

abilities.name: Slowing Sands
abilities.description: Summon a sand vortex that Slows enemies by 10% every 0.25 seconds, up to 70%.

abilities.name: Time Trap - Detonate Time Trap
abilities.description: Detonates active Time Traps, placing all nearby allied or enemy Heroes in Time Stop for 2 seconds.

abilities.name: Demon Lieutenant
abilities.description:
Summon a Demon Lieutenant at any allied Mercenary, Minion, or Azmodan Demon. The Lieutenant will cast Demonic Smite every 7 seconds, instantly killing an enemy Minion. Loses Health over 21 seconds.

Usable while Channeling All Shall Burn.

abilities.name: Globe of Annihilation
abilities.description:
Shoot a globe of destruction, dealing 176 (+4% per level) damage on impact.  Deals 50% damage to non-Heroes.

Quest: Hitting a Hero or killing a Minion within 3 seconds of being hit by Globe Of Annihilation grants 2 stacks of Annihilation.  Each stack increases its damage by 1. 

Mythic Reward: After gaining 450 Annihilation, the area of Globe of Annihilation is increased by 15% and it deals 150 additional damage.

abilities.name: Summon Demon Warrior
abilities.description:
Spawn a Demon Warrior that marches forward. Warriors deal 53 (+4% per level) damage per Attack. Loses Health over 17 seconds. Deals 100% bonus damage to Minions and Mercenaries.

Usable while Channeling All Shall Burn.

abilities.name: All Shall Burn
abilities.description:
Channel a beam of death on an enemy, dealing 128 (+4% per level) damage per second for 2.5 seconds. If the Channel lasts its full duration, deal an extra 340 (+4% per level) damage to the target.

Azmodan's Movement Speed is reduced by 30% while Channeling.

abilities.name: Demonic Invasion
abilities.description:
Rain a small army of Demonic Grunts down on enemies, dealing 85 (+4% per level) damage per impact. Grunts deal 30 (+4% per level) damage, have 750 (+4% per level) Health and last up to 20 seconds. When Grunts die they explode, dealing 40 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies, doubled against enemy Heroes.

Usable while Channeling All Shall Burn.

abilities.name: Tide of Sin
abilities.description:
Activate to make the next Globe of Annihilation cost no Mana and deal 50% more damage.

Usable while Channeling All Shall Burn.

abilities.name: Tailwind
abilities.description: Gain 15% increased Movement Speed after not taking damage for 5 seconds.

abilities.name: Hammerang
abilities.description: Throw out a Hammer that returns to Falstad, dealing 80 (+4% per level) damage and Slowing enemies hit by 25% for 2 seconds. Reactive to explode the Hammer, dealing 95 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Lightning Rod
