abilities.description: Deal 107 (+4% per level) damage to an enemy, and an additional 75 (+4% per level) damage every 0.9 seconds for 4 seconds while close to the target. Deals 100% increased damage to Minions and Mercenaries.

abilities.name: Barrel Roll
abilities.description: Dashes forward and grants a 171 (+4% per level) point Shield for 3 seconds.

abilities.name: Mighty Gust
abilities.description: Push enemies away, and Slow them by 40%, decaying over 4 seconds.

abilities.name: Hinterland Blast
abilities.description: After 1 second, deal 475 (+4.75% per level) damage to enemies within a long line. The cooldown is reduced by 30 seconds for every enemy Hero hit.

abilities.name: Flight
abilities.description: Instead of mounting, Falstad can fly a great distance over terrain.

abilities.name: Shield Capacitor
abilities.description: Fenix has a permanent 760 (+4% per level) Shield which regenerates at 10% per second after not taking damage for 5 seconds.

abilities.name: Plasma Cutter
abilities.description: Create a laser beam at the target point that circles around Fenix twice, dealing 135 (+4% per level) damage to enemies hit and Slowing them by 25% for 4 seconds.

abilities.name: Weapon Mode: Repeater Cannon
abilities.description:
Basic Attack speed increased by 150%.

Activate to change to Weapon Mode: Phase Bomb, increasing Basic Attack range and damage, and causing Basic Attacks to splash.

abilities.name: Warp
abilities.description: Warp to a targeted location, phasing out after 0.5 seconds, and arriving 0.75 seconds later.

abilities.name: Planet Cracker
abilities.description: After 0.5 seconds, Channel a powerful beam that spans across the battleground for 4 seconds, dealing 112 (+4% per level) damage every 0.25 seconds to non-Structure enemies hit.

abilities.name: Purification Salvo
abilities.description: Channel for 1.5 seconds, sweeping a laser in front of Fenix that locks onto enemy Heroes. Once Channeling finishes, fire 5 missiles at each locked Hero, dealing 79 (+4% per level) damage each. Deals 50% increased damage to Slowed targets.

abilities.name: Weapon Mode: Repeater Cannon - Weapon Mode: Phase Bomb
abilities.description:
Basic Attacks have 1.25 increased range, deal 25% more damage, and splash to nearby enemies.

Activate to change to Weapon Mode: Repeater Cannon, increasing Basic Attack speed.

abilities.name: Ogre Rage
abilities.description:
Activate to increase Gall's damage by 25%, but reduce Cho's Armor by 25.

Passive: Gall is permanently immune to Stun and Silence effects.

abilities.name: Shadowflame
abilities.description: Deal 135 (+5% per level) damage to enemies in the area.

abilities.name: Dread Orb
abilities.description: Throw a bomb that will bounce three times, dealing 126 (+5% per level) damage to enemies.

abilities.name: Runic Blast
abilities.description: Detonate Cho's Rune Bomb, dealing 210 (+4% per level) damage around it.

abilities.name: Twisting Nether
abilities.description: After 1 second, nearby enemies are Slowed by 50% while Gall channels, up to 5 seconds. Activate to deal 353 (+5% per level) damage.

abilities.name: Shadow Bolt Volley
abilities.description: After 1 second, unleash 20 Shadow Bolts over 4 seconds, each dealing 87 (+4% per level) damage to the first target hit. The bolts fire towards your mouse.

abilities.name: Eye of Kilrogg
abilities.description: Place an eye, granting vision of a large area around it for 45 seconds. The eye can be killed by enemies with 2 Basic Attacks. Stores up to 2 charges.

abilities.name: Shove
abilities.description: Nudge Cho a small distance and grant him 25% Movement Speed for 2 seconds.

abilities.name: Dread Orb - Double Back
abilities.description: Activate to reverse the third bounce's direction.

abilities.name: Twisting Nether - Detonate Twisting Nether
abilities.description: Detonate the Twisting Nether, dealing 353 (+5% per level) damage.

abilities.name: Cyber Agility
abilities.description: Activate to jump to the target area.

abilities.name: Shuriken
abilities.description:
Throw 3 Shuriken in a spread pattern, each dealing 65 (+4% per level) damage to the first enemy hit.

Stores up to 3 charges. Shuriken's cooldown replenishes all charges at the same time.

abilities.name: Deflect
abilities.description:
Channel for 1.25 seconds, becoming Protected and blocking damage. Any damage blocked while channeling causes Genji to throw a Kunai toward the nearest enemy, prioritizing Heroes and dealing 55 (+4% per level) damage.

Total Damage Deflected: 0

abilities.name: Swift Strike
abilities.description: Dash forward, dealing 190 (+4% per level) damage to all enemies in a line. Enemy Heroes that die within 1.5 seconds of being hit with Swift Strike cause the cooldown and mana cost to be refunded.

abilities.name: Dragonblade
abilities.description: Unleash the Dragonblade for 8 seconds. While active, Dragonblade can be reactivated to lunge forward and slash in a huge arc, dealing 240 (+4% per level) damage.

abilities.name: X-Strike
abilities.description: Perform two slashes dealing 145 (+4% per level) damage. The slashes detonate after 1.25 seconds causing an additional 290 (+4% per level) damage to enemies in their area.

abilities.name: Curse of the Worgen
abilities.description:
Greymane can use certain Abilities to shapeshift between a Human and a Worgen.

While Human, Greymane's Basic Attacks are ranged.

While Worgen, Greymane gains 10 Armor, and his Basic Attacks become melee but deal 40% more damage.

abilities.name: Gilnean Cocktail
abilities.description:
Hurl a flask that deals 55 (+4% per level) damage to the first enemy hit and explodes for 220 (+4% per level) damage to enemies in a cone behind them.

Worgen: Razor Swipe
Swipe forward, damaging enemies hit.

abilities.name: Inner Beast
abilities.description: Gain 50% Attack Speed for 3 seconds. Basic Attacks refresh this duration, and reduce the cooldown of Inner Beast by 0.5 seconds.

abilities.name: Darkflight
abilities.description:
Shapeshift into a Worgen and leap at an enemy dealing 88 (+4% per level) damage.

Worgen: Disengage
Roll away and shapeshift into a Human.

abilities.name: Go for the Throat
abilities.description: Leap at an enemy Hero and shapeshift into a Worgen, slashing for 355 (+4% per level) damage. If this kills them, the Ability can be used a second time within 10 seconds for free.

abilities.name: Cursed Bullet
abilities.description:
Greymane shapeshifts into a Human and fires a bullet that hits the first enemy Hero in its path, dealing 35% of their current Health in damage.

Does not affect Vehicles.

abilities.name: Darkflight - Razor Swipe
abilities.description:
Swipe in the targeted direction, dealing 126 (+4% per level) damage to enemies hit.

Human: Gilnean Cocktail
Damage the first enemy hit and deal heavy damage behind them.

abilities.name: Darkflight - Disengage
abilities.description:
Roll away and shapeshift into a Human.

Human: Darkflight
Leap at an enemy and shapeshift into a Worgen.

abilities.name: Life Tap
abilities.description:
Gul'dan does not regenerate Mana.

Activate to restore 25% of Gul'dan's Mana.

abilities.name: Fel Flame
abilities.description: Release a wave of flame, dealing 210 (+4.5% per level) damage to enemies.

abilities.name: Drain Life
abilities.description: Drain the life from an enemy over 3 seconds, dealing 132 (+4% per level) damage per second and healing Gul'dan for 188 (+4% per level) Health per second.

abilities.name: Corruption
abilities.description: Call forth three bursts of shadow energy, dealing 204 (+4.5% per level) damage over 6 seconds. Corruption can stack up to 3 times on an enemy.

abilities.name: Horrify
abilities.description: After 0.5 seconds, deal 120 (+4% per level) damage to enemy Heroes in an area and Fear them for 2 seconds. While Feared, Heroes are Silenced and are forced to run away from Horrify's center.

abilities.name: Rain of Destruction
abilities.description: After 1.5 seconds, summon a rain of meteors in an area for 7 seconds. Each meteor deals 165 (+4% per level) damage in a small area.

abilities.name: Natural Agility
abilities.description: Jump over unpathable terrain or Structures, up to a maximum range.

abilities.name: Storm Bow
abilities.description: Activate to charge an arrow that deals 291 (+4% per level) damage to the first enemy hit. Storm Bow's range increases the longer it is Channeled.

abilities.name: Scatter Arrow
abilities.description: Fire an arrow that deals 88 (+4% per level) to the first enemy Hero hit. Scatter Arrow can collide with terrain and Structures, splitting into 5 arrows that travel extra distance, ricochet up to 4 additional times, and deal 88 (+4% per level) damage each to the first enemy hit.

abilities.name: Sonic Arrow
abilities.description: Fire an arrow that grants vision in a large area for 5 seconds. Enemies inside are revealed for 1 second. If Sonic Arrow lands directly on an enemy, it deals 165 (+4% per level) damage to them and follows them as they move.

abilities.name: Dragonstrike
abilities.description: After 1.5 seconds, summon a pair of Spirit Dragons which travel forward, dealing 84 (+4% per level) damage every 0.25 seconds to enemy Heroes in its area. Enemies in the center take 75% increased damage.

abilities.name: Dragon's Arrow
abilities.description:
Fire a missile that travels across the battleground. Explodes upon hitting an enemy Hero, dealing 130 (+4% per level) damage to all nearby enemies and Stunning them for 0.5 seconds.

After traveling a medium distance, the damage is increased to 260 (+4% per level) and the Stun duration to 1.25 seconds.

After traveling a long distance, the damage is increased to 390 (+4% per level) and the Stun duration to 2 seconds.

abilities.name: Total Mayhem
abilities.description:
Upon dying, drop 5 grenades that explode after 0.75 seconds, each dealing 250 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies. Deals 75% less damage to Structures.

Detonate Mine

Detonate an active Concussion Mine.

abilities.name: Frag Launcher
abilities.description:
Launch a grenade that explodes at the end of its path or upon hitting an enemy, dealing 124 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies. Grenades can ricochet off of terrain. Deals 50% less damage to Structures.

Stores up to 4 charges. Frag Launcher's cooldown replenishes all charges at the same time.

abilities.name: Concussion Mine
abilities.description:
Place a mine on the ground. Junkrat's Trait can be activated to detonate the mine, dealing 180 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies and knocking them back. Junkrat can also be affected by Concussion Mine, but takes no damage.

Limit 1 active mine.

abilities.name: Steel Trap
abilities.description:
Place a trap on the ground that arms after 2 seconds. Deals 130 (+4% per level) damage to the first enemy that walks over it and Roots them for 2 seconds.

Limit 1 active trap.

abilities.name: RIP-Tire
abilities.description:
Create a motorized bomb with 530 (+4% per level) Health that lasts 15 seconds. While active, Junkrat is immobile but gains control of RIP-Tire's movement.

RIP-Tire can be reactivated to detonate immediately, knocking nearby enemies back and dealing 720 (+4% per level) damage to enemies near the center gradually reduced to 445 (+4% per level) to enemies on the edge.

abilities.name: Rocket Ride
abilities.description:
After 1.25 seconds, Junkrat launches into the air. While in the air, he can steer the landing location by moving.

After 3.75 seconds, Junkrat lands, dealing 935 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies and activating Total Mayhem. 5 seconds after landing, Junkrat reappears at the Hall of Storms and gains 150% additional Movement Speed until dismounted.

abilities.name: Concussion Mine - Detonate Mine
abilities.description: Detonate the planted Concussion Mine, dealing 180 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies and knocking them back. Junkrat can also be affected by Concussion Mine, but takes no damage.

abilities.name: RIP-Tire - Jump!
abilities.description: Activate to make the RIP-Tire jump. Can be used to pass over terrain and Structures.

abilities.name: RIP-Tire - Detonate RIP-Tire
abilities.description: Instantly detonate the RIP-Tire, knocking nearby enemies back, and dealing 720 (+4% per level) damage to enemies near the center gradually reduced to 445 (+4% per level) to enemies on the edge.

abilities.name: Frostbite
abilities.description:
Jaina's Abilities Chill targets, Slowing them by 25% and amplifying damage taken from her Abilities by 50%. Lasts 4 seconds.

Quest: Deal Ability damage to Chilled Heroes.

Reward: Upon dealing 12000 damage, unlock the Improved Ice Block Ability, allowing Jaina to become temporarily Invulnerable.

Mythic Reward: Upon dealing 30000 damage, Ice Block upgrades to Ice Cold, allowing Jaina to move and cast while active.

abilities.name: Frostbolt
abilities.description: Deal 184 (+4% per level) damage and Chill the target.

abilities.name: Blizzard
abilities.description: Bombard an area with 3 waves of ice, dealing 142 (+4% per level) damage each. Damaged enemies are Chilled.

abilities.name: Cone of Cold
abilities.description: Deal 220 (+4% per level) damage and Chill targets.

abilities.name: Summon Water Elemental
abilities.description: Summon a Water Elemental at target location. The Water Elemental's Basic Attacks deal 62 (+4% per level) damage, splash for 25% damage and Chill. The Ability can be reactivated to retarget the Water Elemental. Loses Health over 32 seconds.

abilities.name: Ring of Frost
abilities.description: After a 1.5 second delay, create a Ring of Frost in an area that deals 310 (+4% per level) damage and Roots enemies for 3 seconds. The ring persists for 3 seconds afterward, Chilling any enemies who touch it.

abilities.name: Improved Ice Block
abilities.description: Activate to place Jaina in Stasis and gain Invulnerability for 2.5 seconds. When this effect expires, nearby enemies are Chilled.

abilities.name: Verdant Spheres
abilities.description: Activate to make Kael'thas's next Basic Ability more powerful.

abilities.name: Flamestrike
abilities.description:
After 1 second, deal 345 (+4% per level) damage in an area. 

Verdant Spheres increases the radius by 50%.

abilities.name: Living Bomb
abilities.description:
Deal 126 (+4% per level) damage over 3 seconds to an enemy, then they explode dealing 215 (+4% per level) damage to all nearby enemies.  Other Heroes damaged by this explosion are also affected by Living Bomb, though the secondary explosions cannot spread.

Verdant Spheres makes this Ability cost no Mana and have no cooldown.

abilities.name: Gravity Lapse
abilities.description:
Stun the first enemy hit for 1 second. 

Verdant Spheres causes Gravity Lapse to stun the first 3 enemies hit and increases the stun duration by 50%.

abilities.name: Pyroblast
abilities.description: After 1.5 seconds, cast a slow-moving fireball that deals 810 (+5% per level) damage to an enemy Hero and 405 (+5% per level) damage to enemies nearby.

abilities.name: Phoenix
abilities.description: Launch a Phoenix to an area, dealing 84 (+4% per level) damage to enemies along the way. The Phoenix persists for 7 seconds, attacking enemies for 84 (+4% per level) damage and splashing for 42 (+4% per level) damage.

abilities.name: Master of the Cold Dark
abilities.description:
Quest: Gain 1 Blight every time a Hero is Rooted by Frost Nova or hit by Chains of Kel'Thuzad.

Reward: After gaining 15 Blight, gain the Glacial Spike Ability.

Reward: After gaining 30 Blight, gain 75% Spell Power.

Blight: 0/30

abilities.name: Death and Decay
abilities.description: After 0.5 seconds, launch an orb that explodes upon hitting an enemy, dealing 150 (+2.5% per level) damage to enemies in the area. The explosion leaves behind a pool of decay that lasts 2 seconds, dealing 82 (+2.5% per level) damage every 0.5 seconds to enemies.

abilities.name: Frost Nova
abilities.description: Create a nova that explodes after 1 second, dealing 180 (+2.5% per level) damage to enemies inside and Slowing them by 35% for 2.5 seconds. Enemies in the center are Rooted for 1 second.

abilities.name: Chains of Kel'Thuzad
abilities.description: Launch a chain, dealing 97 (+2.5% per level) damage to the first enemy Hero hit. For 3 seconds after hitting an enemy, Chains can be reactivated to launch to an additional enemy, pulling both enemies together and Stunning them for 0.5 seconds.

abilities.name: Frost Blast
abilities.description: Launch a meteor of ice at an enemy Hero. Upon impact, the meteor deals 115 (+2.5% per level) damage to its target and 275 (+2.5% per level) damage to enemies in the area. All enemies hit by Frost Blast are Rooted for 2 seconds.

abilities.name: Shadow Fissure
abilities.description: Create a fissure anywhere on the Battleground that explodes after 1.5 seconds, dealing 320 (+2.5% per level) damage to enemy Heroes in its area. If an enemy Hero is hit, set its cooldown to 1.5 seconds.

abilities.name: Glacial Spike
abilities.description: Activate to create a spike that detonates after 4 seconds, dealing 70 (+2.5% per level) damage to nearby enemies. The spike can be affected by Chains of Kel'Thuzad.

abilities.name: Voodoo Ritual
abilities.description:
Nazeebo's Basic Attacks and Abilities poison Non-Heroic enemies, causing them to take 66 (+4% per level) additional damage over 6 seconds. 

Quest: If a Minion dies while poisoned by Voodoo Ritual, Nazeebo permanently gains 6 Health and 1 Mana.

abilities.name: Corpse Spiders
abilities.description: Hurl a jar of spiders that deals 50 (+4% per level) damage. If it hits at least one enemy, create 3 Corpse Spiders that attack for 38 (+4% per level) damage. Spiders last for 4 seconds.

abilities.name: Zombie Wall
abilities.description: After 1 second, create a ring of Zombies surrounding the target area that deal 28 (+4% per level) damage and last for 3 seconds.

abilities.name: Plague of Toads
abilities.description:
Create a wave of 3 Toads that explode on contact, dealing 126 (+4% per level) damage over 6 seconds. This effect stacks.

Stores up to 2 charges.

abilities.name: Gargantuan
abilities.description: Summon a Gargantuan to guard an area, losing Health over 29 seconds. Deals 100 (+4% per level) damage when summoned, attacks for 140 (+4% per level) damage, and can be ordered to stomp nearby enemies. The Gargantuan's Stomp deals 240 (+4% per level) damage and Slows by 30% for 2 seconds.

abilities.name: Ravenous Spirit
abilities.description: Channel a Ravenous Spirit that deals 230 (+4% per level) damage per second. Cannot move while channeling. Lasts for 8 seconds.

abilities.name: Gargantuan Stomp
abilities.description: Order the Gargantuan to stomp, dealing 240 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies and Slowing them by 30% for 2 seconds.

abilities.name: Lord Of Hatred
abilities.description:
Hitting enemy Heroes with Basic Abilities reduces Mephisto's Basic Ability cooldowns.

Skull Missile and Shade of Mephisto grant 1.5 seconds of cooldown reduction per Hero hit, and Lightning Nova grants 0.3 seconds per Hero hit.

abilities.name: Skull Missile
abilities.description: Conjure a skull that travels in the target direction after 0.625 seconds, dealing 127 (+4% per level) damage to enemies hit and Slowing Heroes hit by 25% for 2 seconds.

abilities.name: Lightning Nova
abilities.description:
A ring of lightning appears around Mephisto for 2.5 seconds. Enemies within the ring take 43 (+4% per level) damage every 0.25 seconds.

Each time a cast of Lightning Nova hits a Hero, its damage is increased by 3%, up to 30%.

abilities.name: Shade of Mephisto
abilities.description:
Teleport to a location, dealing 78 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies and leaving behind a Shade of Mephisto at Mephisto's original location. 

After 2.5 seconds, Mephisto is teleported back to the Shade's location.

abilities.name: Consume Souls
abilities.description: Channel for 2.5 seconds, revealing all enemy Heroes. After the Channel completes, all enemy Heroes take 357 (+4% per level) damage and are Slowed by 25% for 2.5 seconds.

abilities.name: Durance of Hate
abilities.description:
After 1 second, unleash a wave of evil spirits that Root the first enemy Hero hit for 2.5 seconds and deal 250 (+4% per level) damage to them over the same duration.

Durance of Hate spreads outwards from its initial target, Rooting and damaging additional nearby enemy Heroes.

abilities.name: Critical Mass
abilities.description: Getting a Takedown will refresh the cooldown on all of Li-Ming's Abilities.

abilities.name: Magic Missiles
abilities.description: Fire three missiles toward an area, each dealing 147 (+3.5% per level) damage to the first enemy hit. These missiles do 50% damage to Structures.

abilities.name: Arcane Orb
abilities.description: Fire an Orb that powers up as it travels, dealing 135 (+3% per level) damage to the first enemy hit. Damage is increased the further it travels, up to 270 (+3% per level) more damage.

abilities.name: Teleport
abilities.description: Teleport a short distance instantly.

abilities.name: Disintegrate
abilities.description: Channel a powerful beam, dealing 480 (+5% per level) damage over 2.6 seconds to enemies while they are in it. The direction of the beam changes with your mouse cursor position.

abilities.name: Wave of Force
abilities.description: Knock away all enemies from an area and deal 160 (+5% per level) damage.

abilities.name: Nature's Toxin
abilities.description: Lunara's Basic Attacks and damaging Abilities poison their target, dealing 33 (+4% per level) damage a second for 3 seconds. Every additional application increases the duration by 3 seconds, up to a maximum of 9 seconds.

abilities.name: Noxious Blossom
abilities.description: After 0.5 seconds, cause an area to explode with pollen dealing 160 (+4% per level) damage.

abilities.name: Crippling Spores
abilities.description: Enemies currently afflicted by Nature's Toxin have its duration increased by 3 seconds and are Slowed by 40%, decaying over 3 seconds.

abilities.name: Wisp
abilities.description: Spawn a Wisp to scout an area. Can be redirected once active. When the Wisp is in a bush for more 2 seconds, its vision radius is increased by 75%. Lasts 45 seconds.

abilities.name: Thornwood Vine
abilities.description:
Send forth vines that deal 184 (+4% per level) damage to all enemies in a line.

Stores up to 3 charges.

abilities.name: Leaping Strike
abilities.description:
Leap over an enemy, Slowing them by 80% for 0.35 seconds and dealing 271 (+4% per level) damage.

Stores up to 2 charges.

abilities.name: Dryad's Swiftness
abilities.description: Lunara moves 20% faster by leaping short distances.

abilities.name: Wisp - Relocate Wisp
abilities.description: Moves the Wisp to a new location.

abilities.name: Permanent Cloak
abilities.description:
Gain Stealth when out of combat for 3 seconds. Taking damage, attacking, using Abilities, or Channeling ends Stealth. Remaining stationary for at least 1.5 seconds while Stealthed grants Invisible.

Passive: Gain 15% Movement Speed while Stealthed.

abilities.name: Snipe
abilities.description:
Deal 230 (+4% per level) damage to the first enemy hit.

Passive: Hitting an enemy Hero with Snipe permanently increases the damage of Snipe by 6%, stacking up to 30%. Gain an additional 25% damage bonus at maximum stacks. All stacks are lost if Snipe fails to hit an enemy.

abilities.name: Pinning Shot
abilities.description: Deal 100 (+4% per level) damage to an enemy and Slow them by 40% for 2.25 seconds.

abilities.name: Holo Decoy
abilities.description:
Create a Decoy for 5 seconds with 100% of Nova's current Health that attacks enemies, dealing 10% of Nova's base damage. Whenever a Decoy takes damage, it deals that amount of damage to itself, effectively doubling the damage it takes.

Using this Ability does not break Stealth.

abilities.name: Triple Tap
abilities.description: Locks in on the target Hero, then fires 3 shots that hit the first Hero or Structure they come in contact with for 372 (+4% per level) damage each.

abilities.name: Precision Strike
abilities.description: After a 1.5 second delay, deals 435 (+4% per level) damage to enemies within an area. Unlimited range.

abilities.name: Ghost Protocol
abilities.description: Activate to instantly grant Stealth to Nova and spawn a Holo Decoy at her location. Nova is Unrevealable for the first 0.5 seconds when Stealthed by Ghost Protocol.

abilities.name: Warp In Pylon
abilities.description:
Warp in a Pylon that generates a Power Field and grants vision of the surrounding area. Probius only regenerates mana while inside a Power Field. Enemy Heroes and Minions drop Minerals when killed. Gather Minerals to reduce the cooldown of Warp In Pylon by 0.75 seconds.

Up to 2 Pylons can be active at a time.

abilities.name: Disruption Pulse
abilities.description:
Fire a burst of energy forward, dealing 142 (+5% per level) damage to all enemies it passes through.

Hitting the center of a Warp Rift will cause it to explode, dealing additional damage.

abilities.name: Warp Rift
abilities.description:
Open an unstable Warp Rift at a location that takes 1.25 seconds to arm, which then Slows nearby enemies by 25% lasting 3 seconds.

Armed Warp Rifts explode when they expire or when hit by Disruption Pulse, dealing 261 (+5% per level) damage to nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Photon Cannon
abilities.description:
Warp in a Photon Cannon that deals 105 (+4% per level) damage. Lasts for 13 seconds.

While within a Pylon's Power Field, Photon Cannons gain 40% Attack Speed over 4 seconds and reveal nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Pylon Overcharge
abilities.description: For 8 seconds, increase the size of Pylon power fields and allow them to attack enemy Heroes within it for 96 (+4% per level) damage per second. Pylons are Invulnerable for the duration.

abilities.name: Null Gate
abilities.description:
Vector Targeting
Project a barrier of negative energy in the target direction that lasts 4 seconds. Enemies who touch the barrier take 76 (+4% per level) damage per second and are Slowed by 80% for as long as they remain in contact with it.

abilities.name: Worker Rush
abilities.description:
Activate to gain an additional 60% Movement Speed for 5 seconds. Taking damage ends this effect early. Worker Rush is always active while at the Hall of Storms.

Passive: Probius moves 10% faster by hovering over the ground.

abilities.name: Overflowing Chaos
abilities.description:
Hitting an enemy Hero with a Basic Ability grants 1 Chaos. Chaos can stack up to 3 times.

While Orphea has Chaos, her Basic Attacks against Heroes consume all Chaos, dealing 50% increased damage per stack, and healing for 100% of the damage dealt.

abilities.name: Shadow Waltz
abilities.description:
After 0.5 seconds, deal 165 (+4% per level) damage to enemies in a line. 

Hitting a Hero with Shadow Waltz sets its cooldown to 2 seconds, refunds 35 Mana, and causes Orphea to dash a short distance upon moving.

abilities.name: Chomp
abilities.description: After 0.625 seconds, deal 305 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies in front of Orphea.

abilities.name: Dread
abilities.description: Release a wave of dread that deals 85 (+4% per level) damage to enemies hit. Dread erupts 0.75 seconds after reaching the end of its path, dealing 175 (+4% per level) damage. Enemies hit by Dread's wave or eruption are Slowed by 25% for 2 seconds.

abilities.name: Crushing Jaws
abilities.description: After 1.25 seconds, pull enemies in an area towards the center, dealing 250 (+4% per level) damage and Stunning them for 0.5 seconds.

abilities.name: Eternal Feast
abilities.description: After 1.5 seconds, deal 210 (+4% per level) damage in an area. Eternal Feast repeats every 1 second as long as it hits an enemy Hero.

abilities.name: Siege Mode
abilities.description: Activate to enter Siege Mode. While in Siege Mode, Basic Attacks deal 20% more damage, have 100% increased range, and deal 25% of their damage as splash damage around the target.

abilities.name: Spider Mines
abilities.description:
Create 3 mines that arm after 1.25 seconds. Mines detonate when an enemy comes in range, dealing 96 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies and Slowing them by 25% for 1.5 seconds.

Siege Mode: Cast range increased by 100%.

abilities.name: Concussive Blast
abilities.description:
Deal 141 (+4% per level) damage to enemies in front of Sgt. Hammer and knock them back.

Siege Mode: Radius increased by 50%.

abilities.name: Neosteel Plating
abilities.description:
Gain 25 Armor for 2 seconds.

Siege Mode: Grants 100% more Armor.

abilities.name: Napalm Strike
abilities.description: Deals 164 (+4% per level) damage on impact, and leaves a napalm area that deals 50 (+4% per level) damage per second. Lasts for 4 seconds.

abilities.name: Blunt Force Gun
abilities.description: Fire a missile across the battlefield, dealing 500 (+3% per level) damage to enemies in its path.  Deals 50% damage to Structures.

abilities.name: Thrusters
abilities.description: Increase Movement Speed by 60% for 4 seconds. Thrusters are always active while at the Hall of Storms. Activating Thrusters cancels Siege Mode.

abilities.name: Siege Mode - Tank Mode
abilities.description: Return to Tank Mode

abilities.name: Give 'Em Some Pepper
abilities.description: Every 4th Basic Attack splashes in a small area and deals 125% more damage to the main target.

abilities.name: Penetrating Round
abilities.description: Deal 205 (+4% per level) damage, knock back, and Slow enemies in a line by 20% for 2 seconds. Enemies close to Raynor are knocked back further.

abilities.name: Inspire
abilities.description:
Raynor and all nearby allied Minions and Mercenaries gain 30% Attack Speed and 10% Movement Speed for 4 seconds.

Casting Inspire resets Raynor's Basic Attack cooldown.

abilities.name: Adrenaline Rush
abilities.description: Heal Raynor for 25% of his maximum Health over 1 second. Raynor's Basic Attacks reduce this cooldown by 0.5 seconds, increased to 1 second against Heroes.

abilities.name: Hyperion
abilities.description: Order the Hyperion to make a strafing run for 12 seconds, hitting up to 4 enemies for 66 (+4% per level) damage every second. Every 4 seconds, it can fire its Yamato Cannon at a Structure, dealing 794 (+4% per level) damage.

abilities.name: Raynor's Raider
abilities.description:
Summon a Banshee that assists Raynor. The Banshee deals 84 (+4% per level) damage per second and regenerates 75 (+4% per level) Health per second if it hasn't taken damage in the last 4 seconds. Can reactivate to retarget or move the Banshee.

The Banshee respawns automatically after 45 seconds.

abilities.name: Black Arrows
abilities.description:
Basic Attacks infect enemies with Black Arrows for 3 seconds, stacking up to 3 times. Sylvanas deals 15% more damage to enemies with 3 stacks.

Quest: Damage Heroes and Structures with 3 stacks of Black Arrows.

Reward: Upon damaging enemies 250 times, increase the damage bonus provided by Black Arrows to 50%.

Mythic Reward: Upon damaging enemies 400 times, Black Arrows now heals Sylvanas for 25% of damage dealt at 3 stacks, doubled against Heroes.

abilities.name: Withering Fire
abilities.description: Shoot the closest enemy up to 5 times over 1.5 seconds for 39 (+4% per level) damage, prioritizing Heroes. Cooldown is reset on getting a Takedown.

abilities.name: Shadow Dagger
abilities.description: Throw a dagger at a target enemy that deals 30 (+4% per level) damage and an additional 150 (+4% per level) damage over 2.5 seconds. Damage dealt by Sylvanas to the initial target spreads Shadow Dagger to all nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Haunting Wave
abilities.description: Send forth a wave of banshees dealing 114 (+4% per level) damage to all targets. Reactivate to teleport to the banshees' location.

abilities.name: Wailing Arrow
abilities.description: Shoot an arrow that can be reactivated to deal 228 (+4% per level) damage and Silence enemies in an area for 2.5 seconds. The arrow detonates automatically if it reaches maximum range.

abilities.name: Mind Control
abilities.description: After 0.25 seconds, fire a missile that Mind Controls the first enemy Hero hit. Heroes hit are Silenced, Slowed by 30%, have 3 stacks of Black Arrows applied to them, and are forced to walk towards Sylvanas for 1.75 seconds.

abilities.name: Possession
abilities.description: Activate to force an enemy Minion to fight for Sylvanas's team. Catapults require 3 charges. Stores up to 4 charges.

abilities.name: Haunting Wave - Haunting Teleport
abilities.description: Activate to teleport to the banshees' location.

abilities.name: Resonance Beam
abilities.description:
Tassadar's Basic Attack is a Channeled beam that Slows by 15%. While Channeling, your Basic Attack damage and Mana regeneration increases by 25% a second, to a maximum of 100%. While at full charge, gain an extra 3 Mana every second.

This bonus is lost after 6 seconds of not Channeling.

abilities.name: Shock Ray
abilities.description: Channel a beam of Psionic energy, dealing 280 (+4% per level) damage and Slowing enemies in a line by 30% for 2 seconds.

abilities.name: Psionic Storm
abilities.description: Create a Psionic Storm at the targeted location for 3 seconds. While in a storm, enemies take 38 (+4% per level) damage every 0.5 seconds, increasing by 20% for each consecutive instance of damage, up to 100%.

abilities.name: Force Wall
abilities.description: After a 0.5 second delay, create a wall that blocks all units from moving through it for 2 seconds.

abilities.name: Archon
abilities.description:
Tassadar transforms into an Archon, gaining a Shield equal to 25% of his maximum Health and empowering Resonance Beam. Lasts for 12 seconds.

Resonance Beam: Deals 140 (+4% per level) damage to the target and splashes 70 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies. Heroes hit have their Spell Armor reduced by 20 for 2 seconds. Resonance Beam is fully charged while Archon is active.

abilities.name: Black Hole
abilities.description: After a 0.5 second cast, create a Black Hole that travels in a long line. Enemy Heroes within the Black Hole's area are quickly pulled towards its center. Touching the center deals 310 (+4% per level) damage and Stuns the target for 1.25 seconds.

abilities.name: Reload
abilities.description:
Tracer can Basic Attack while moving, and after attacking 10 times she needs to reload over 0.75 seconds. Tracer can manually reload early by activating Reload.

Basic Attacks heal Tracer for 10% of the damage dealt.

abilities.name: Blink
abilities.description:
Dash towards an area.

Stores up to 3 charges.

abilities.name: Melee
abilities.description: Deal 220 (+4% per level) damage to a nearby enemy, prioritizing Heroes. Gain 5% Pulse Bomb charge when using Melee against an enemy, and 10% against Heroes.

abilities.name: Recall
abilities.description: After 1.25 seconds, Tracer returns to the position she was at 2 seconds prior to casting, refilling her ammo, and removing all negative status effects from herself.

abilities.name: Pulse Bomb
abilities.description:
Fire a short range bomb that can attach to an enemy if it hits them. The bomb explodes after 2 seconds dealing 298 (+6% per level) damage to them and 149 (+6% per level) damage to other nearby enemies.

This ability is slowly charged over time by dealing damage to enemies with Basic Attacks and Melee.

abilities.name: Minigun
abilities.description: Activate to have Basic Attacks against Heroes deal bonus damage equal to 2.5% of their maximum Health. Lasts 3 seconds.

abilities.name: Overkill
abilities.description: Deal 552 (+4% per level) damage to the target and 276 (+4% per level) damage to nearby targets over 4 seconds. Reactivate to select a new target or direction. Can move and use Abilities while Channeling.

abilities.name: Frag Grenade
abilities.description: Lob a grenade that deals 256 (+4% per level) damage, knocking enemies away.

abilities.name: Run and Gun
abilities.description: Dash a short distance.

abilities.name: Drakken Laser Drill
abilities.description: Call down a Laser Drill to attack nearby enemies, dealing 142 (+4% per level) damage every second. Reactivate to assign a new target. Loses Health over 25 seconds.

abilities.name: Commandeer Odin
abilities.description: Call down an Odin to pilot. The Odin deals increased Damage, has 100% increased Basic Attack range, and uses different Abilities. The Odin has 25 Armor and lasts 23 seconds.

abilities.name: Commandeer Odin - Annihilate
abilities.description: Fire the Odin's cannons in a straight line, dealing 196 (+4% per level) damage to everything in the path.

abilities.name: Commandeer Odin - Ragnarok Missiles
abilities.description: Launches a volley of missiles at target area, dealing 132 (+4% per level) damage and slowing enemy Movement Speed by 30% for 2 seconds.

abilities.name: Commandeer Odin - Thrusters
abilities.description: Dash in target direction.

abilities.name: Hatred
abilities.description: Basic Attacks grant a stack of Hatred, up to 10. Each Hatred stack increases Basic Attack damage by 8% and Movement Speed by 1%. Lasts 5 seconds.

abilities.name: Hungering Arrow
abilities.description: Fire an arrow that deals 140 (+4% per level) damage to the first target hit, then seeks up to 2 additional enemies, prioritizing Heroes, dealing 80 (+4% per level) damage. Can hit an enemy multiple times.

abilities.name: Multishot
abilities.description: Deal 159 (+4% per level) damage to enemies within the target area.

abilities.name: Vault
abilities.description: Dash to the target area. Valla's next Basic Attack within 2 seconds deals 6% increased damage per stack of Hatred.

abilities.name: Strafe
abilities.description: Rapidly attack enemies within 10 range for 70 (+4% per level) damage per hit, prioritizing Heroes over Minions. Valla is able to move and use Vault while strafing. Lasts for 4 seconds.

abilities.name: Rain of Vengeance
abilities.description:
Launch a wave of Shadow Beasts that deals 250 (+4% per level) damage and Stuns enemies in the target area for 0.5 seconds.

Stores up to 2 charges.

abilities.name: Void Volley
abilities.description: Basic Attacks build Soul Essence. At full Essence, unleash a barrage of void bolts at a target area while moving freely. Tied to the Void Whispers Quest, which rewards range, faster charge, and piercing, empowered void damage as it progresses.

abilities.name: Shadow Mark
abilities.cooldown: the Dark Heart moves to the impact point and detonates on marked Heroes. seconds
abilities.description: Cast a large Void Orb that marks Heroes hit by its inner radius

abilities.name: Void Step
abilities.cooldown: can be cancelled early to reposition or escape. seconds
abilities.description: Blink between three points in a triangular pattern, gaining Attack Damage at each stop

abilities.name: Dark Heart Ritual
abilities.description: Summon the Dark Heart talisman to pulse void energy at nearby enemies, then follow and detonate on any Shadow-Marked Hero.

abilities.name: Void Eruption
abilities.description: Channel a growing void orb, launch it to blind enemies and dominate space, then detonate in a large area — cast on the Dark Heart for an instant, fully empowered eruption. Void

abilities.name: Convergence
abilities.description: Summon a portal that spawns relentless void minions to overwhelm nearby enemies, replacing fallen minions until the portal ends or is destroyed.

abilities.name: Berserker
abilities.description:
Activate to increase Basic Attack damage by 25% but consume 2% maximum Health per attack.

Passive: Zul'jin attacks 1% faster for every 1% of maximum Health missing.

You Want Axe?

Quest: Every 5 Basic Attacks against Heroes permanently increases Basic Attack damage by 1.

Reward: After attacking Heroes 75 times, Basic Attack range is increased by 1.1.

Reward: After attacking Heroes 150 times, Twin Cleave now revolves twice.

Lose 3 stacks on death.

abilities.name: Grievous Throw
abilities.description: Zul'jin throws an axe forward, dealing 125 (+4% per level) damage to the first 2 enemies hit and marking them for 6 seconds. Marked enemies take 50% bonus damage from Zul'jin's next 3 Basic Attacks against them.

abilities.name: Twin Cleave
abilities.description: Throw 2 axes in a large, circular arc, dealing 112 (+4% per level) damage and Slowing affected enemies by 15% per axe for 2 seconds.

abilities.name: Regeneration
abilities.description: Zul'jin channels to regenerate 30% of his maximum Health over 4 seconds. Moving while channeling or taking damage will interrupt this effect.

abilities.name: Taz'dingo!
abilities.description: For the next 4 seconds, Zul'jin is Unkillable, and cannot be reduced to less than 1 Health. Taz'dingo!

abilities.name: Guillotine
abilities.description: Zul'jin launches a massive axe into the air that drops on the targeted area, dealing 330 (+4% per level) damage plus bonus damage the lower his Health is.

abilities.name: Amani Rage
abilities.description: Activate to cause Zul'jin to instantly lose 50% of his current Health and heal for that amount over 10 seconds.

abilities.name: Creep Tumor
abilities.description:
Lay a Creep Tumor that generates Creep. While on Creep, Zagara moves 20% faster and her summons move 30% faster. Tumors lose Health over 250 seconds and reveal the surrounding area while active.

Stores up to 3 charges.

abilities.name: Baneling Barrage
abilities.description:
Launch 2 Banelings that deal 80 (+4% per level) damage to enemies they hit.

Stores up to 2 charges.

abilities.name: Hunter Killer
abilities.description: Summon a Hydralisk to attack a single target, dealing 71 (+5% per level) damage per second. The Hydralisk loses Health over 10 seconds, and has 450 (+4.5% per level) Health.

abilities.name: Infested Drop
abilities.description:
Bombard target area with a Zerg Drop Pod for 140 (+4% per level) damage. 

The pod spawns 2 Roachlings that deal 30 (+4% per level) damage per second and lose Health over 10 seconds.

abilities.name: Nydus Network
abilities.description:
Summon a Nydus Worm on Creep anywhere that Zagara has vision. Zagara can enter a Nydus Worm and travel to any other Nydus Worm by right-clicking near it. While inside a Nydus Worm, Zagara regenerates 10% Health and Mana per second.

Stores up to 2 charges. Maximum of 4 Nydus Worms at a time.

Passive: Creep spreads 15% farther. 
Passive: While on Creep, each Basic Attack reduces all of Zagara's cooldowns by 0.4 seconds.

abilities.name: Devouring Maw
abilities.description:
Summon a Devouring Maw that devours enemies for 4 seconds. Devoured enemies cannot fight and take 94 (+4% per level) damage per second.

Usable on Unstoppable enemies.

abilities.name: Locust Strain
abilities.description:
Spawns a Locust to attack down the nearest lane every 15 seconds.  Locusts heal for 20% of the damage they deal, and regain 20% of their Maximum health when a nearby minion dies.

Locusts lose health over 17 seconds, have 225 (+4% per level) health and deal 36 (+4% per level) damage with each Basic Attack, dealing 100% bonus damage to enemy non-Heroes.

abilities.name: Symbiote
abilities.description: Spawn and attach a Symbiote to a target ally or Structure. While active, Abathur controls the Symbiote, gaining access to new Abilities. The Symbiote is able to gain XP from nearby enemy deaths.

abilities.name: Toxic Nest
abilities.description:
Spawn a mine that becomes active after a short time. Deals 153 (+4% per level) damage and reveals the enemy for 4 seconds. Lasts 90 seconds.

Stores up to 3 charges.

abilities.name: Evolve Monstrosity
abilities.description:
Turn an allied Minion or Locust into a Monstrosity. When enemy Minions near the Monstrosity die, it gains 2% Health and 2% Basic Attack damage, stacking up to 40 times. The Monstrosity can be healed by Carapace and has the ability to Burrow to a visible location every 80 seconds.

Using Symbiote on the Monstrosity allows Abathur to control it, in addition to Symbiote's normal benefits. This Ability can be reactivated to automatically cast Symbiote on his Monstrosity.

abilities.name: Ultimate Evolution
abilities.description: Clone target allied Hero and control it for 20 seconds. Abathur has perfected the clone, granting it 20% Spell Power, 20% bonus Attack Damage, and 10% bonus Movement Speed. Cannot use their Heroic Ability.

abilities.name: Deep Tunnel
abilities.description: Quickly tunnel to a visible location.

abilities.name: Symbiote - Stab
abilities.description: Shoots a spike towards target area that deals 119 (+4% per level) damage to the first enemy it contacts.

abilities.name: Symbiote - Spike Burst
abilities.description: Deals 120 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Symbiote - Carapace
abilities.description: Shields the assisted ally for 150 (+4% per level). Allied Heroes are healed for 22 (+4% per level) Health per second while the Shield is active. Lasts for 6 seconds.

abilities.name: Viking Hoard
abilities.description:
Gathering a Regeneration Globe with a Viking permanently increases all their Health Regeneration by 0.5 per second.

Current Bonus: 0 Regen per second

abilities.name: Longboat Raid!
abilities.description:
Hop into an Unstoppable Longboat that fires at nearby enemies for 128 (+4% per level) damage per second and can fire a mortar that deals 228 (+4% per level) damage in an area.  The boat has increased Health for each Viking inside. If the boat is destroyed by enemies, all Vikings are Stunned for 1 second. Lasts 15 seconds.

Requires all surviving Vikings to be nearby.

abilities.name: Play Again!
abilities.description:
Summon, fully heal, and revive all Lost Vikings at target location after a Viking channels for 2 seconds. 

Only one Viking may attempt to summon at a time.

abilities.name: Select Olaf
abilities.description:
Olaf can charge enemies and slow their Movement Speed by 30% for 3 seconds by right-clicking on them. 8 second cooldown. 

Olaf gains increased Health Regeneration when out of combat for 4 seconds.

abilities.name: Select Baleog
abilities.description: Baleog's Basic Attacks deal 50% damage to enemies behind his attack target.

abilities.name: Select Erik
abilities.description: Erik moves faster than the other Vikings and has increased Basic Attack range.

abilities.name: Select All Vikings
abilities.description: The Lost Vikings can be controlled individually or as a group. Each Viking has particular strengths.

abilities.name: Go Go Go!
abilities.description: The Vikings gain 30% increased Movement Speed for 4 seconds.

abilities.name: Raven Form
abilities.description: Instead of mounting, Medivh can transform into a raven, increasing Movement Speed by 20%. While transformed, Medivh can see and fly over all terrain and is immune to all effects.

abilities.name: Arcane Rift
abilities.description:
Launch a rift that deals 170 (+4% per level) damage to enemies in its path. If an enemy Hero is hit, reduce its cooldown by 5 seconds and refund 50 Mana.

Quest: Hit 40 enemy Heroes with Arcane Rift without dying.

Reward: Permanently increase the damage dealt by 75 and cooldown reduction for hitting a Hero by 1 second.

abilities.name: Force of Will
abilities.description: Protect an allied Hero from all damage for 1.5 seconds. Upon expiration, Force of Will heals the target for 20% of the damage it absorbed.

abilities.name: Portal
abilities.description: Create a set of portals between Medivh and the target location, allowing allies to teleport between both. The portals last 6 seconds.

abilities.name: Poly Bomb
abilities.description: Polymorph an enemy Hero for 2 seconds, Silencing them and making them unable to attack. On expiration, Poly Bomb spreads to other nearby enemy Heroes.

abilities.name: Ley Line Seal
abilities.description: After 0.5 seconds, unleash a wave of energy that places enemy Heroes in Time Stop for 3 seconds.

abilities.name: Raven Form
abilities.description: Transform into a raven, increasing Movement Speed by 20%. While transformed, Medivh can see and fly over terrain and is immune to all effects.

abilities.name: Energy
abilities.description: Each time Zarya's Personal Barrier or Shield Ally absorbs 9 (+4% per level) damage, her Energy is increased by 1. Each point of Energy increases Zarya's damage by 2%. After 0.5 seconds, Energy decays by 3 per second.

abilities.name: Particle Grenade
abilities.description:
Launch a particle grenade that deals 80 (+4% per level) damage to enemies within the area. Deals 50% damage to Structures.

Stores up to 4 charges.

abilities.name: Personal Barrier
abilities.description: Gain a Shield that absorbs 560 (+4% per level) damage for 3 seconds.

abilities.name: Shield Ally
abilities.description: Grants an allied Hero a Shield that absorbs 420 (+4% per level) damage for 3 seconds.

abilities.name: Graviton Surge
abilities.description: Launch a gravity bomb that detonates after 1 second and draws enemy Heroes toward the center for 2.5 seconds. Affected Heroes take 30 (+4% per level) damage a second.

abilities.name: Expulsion Zone
abilities.description: Launch a gravity bomb that deals 124 (+4% per level) damage and creates an expulsion zone for 3.5 seconds. Enemies who enter the affected area are knocked back and have their Movement Speed reduced by 50% for 1 second.

abilities.name: Scarab Host
abilities.description: Using an Ability spawns a Beetle which loses Health over 10 seconds, attacking nearby enemies for 20 (+4% per level) damage.

abilities.name: Impale
abilities.description: Deals 90 (+4% per level) damage. Stuns for 1 second.

abilities.name: Harden Carapace
abilities.description: Gain a Shield that grants 40 Spell Armor and absorbs 340 (+4% per level) damage over 3 seconds.

abilities.name: Burrow Charge
abilities.description:
Burrow to the target location, dealing 91 (+4% per level) damage and briefly stunning enemies in a small area upon surfacing, slowing them by 25% for 2.5 seconds.

Burrow Charge can be reactivated to surface early.

abilities.name: Locust Swarm
abilities.description: Deal 68 (+4% per level) damage per second to nearby enemies. Each enemy damaged restores 24 (+4% per level) Health. Lasts 6 seconds.

abilities.name: Cocoon
abilities.description: Wraps target enemy Hero in a cocoon, rendering them unable to act or be targeted for 7 seconds. Allies of the Hero can attack the cocoon to break it and free them early.

abilities.name: Pyromania
abilities.description:
Gain 40 Armor and deal 40 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies every 0.5 seconds for 4 seconds.

Each Hero hit by Flame Stream reduces Pyromania's cooldown by 4 seconds.

abilities.name: Flame Stream
abilities.description: Fire two streams that deal 76 (+4% per level) damage to enemies hit, and an additional 120 (+4% per level) damage to non-Structure enemies hit by both streams. Flame Stream Ignites Oil Spills it comes in contact with.

abilities.name: Oil Spill
abilities.description:
Vector Targeting
Dispense a slick of oil that lasts for 5 seconds and Slows enemies that come in contact with it by 50%.

Oil Spills are Ignited for 2.5 seconds when hit by Flame Stream. Ignited Oil Spills no longer Slow enemies, but instead deal 16 (+4% per level) damage to them every 0.3 seconds. Additionally, Blaze is healed for 49 (+4% per level) Health every 0.3 seconds while standing in Ignited Oil Spills.

Stores up to 2 charges.

abilities.name: Jet Propulsion
abilities.description: After 0.375 seconds, charge forward. Colliding with an enemy Hero deals 52 (+4% per level) damage to all nearby enemy Heroes and Stuns them for 1.25 seconds.

abilities.name: Bunker Drop
abilities.description:
After 0.5 seconds, deploy and enter a Bunker with 1435 (+4% per level) Health. Blaze and his allies can enter and exit the Bunker at will. While in the Bunker, occupants gain access to Flamethrower, dealing 150 (+4% per level) damage to enemies in a line. 

Exiting the Bunker grants 25 Armor for 2 seconds. Bunkers last 10 seconds, or until destroyed.

abilities.name: Combustion
abilities.description:
Channel for up to 2.6 seconds. Upon ending, Slow nearby enemies by 60% and deal 55 (+4% per level) damage to them every 0.5 seconds. Combustion's Slow and damage over time duration is extended the longer Blaze Channels, from 1 second up to 5 seconds.

Blaze's Movement Speed is reduced by 40% while Channeling.

abilities.name: Bunker - Flamethrower
abilities.description: Deal 150 (+4% per level) damage to enemies in a line.

abilities.name: Ogre Hide
abilities.description: Activate to gain 25 Armor, but reduce Gall's damage by 25%.

abilities.name: Surging Fist
abilities.description: Activate to begin charging Surging Fist. Activate again to dash forward, knocking aside enemies and dealing 46 (+4% per level) damage. The dash range increases by up to 250%, depending on how long it is charged.

abilities.name: Consuming Blaze
abilities.description: Ignite nearby enemies, dealing 150 (+4% per level) damage over 5 seconds. Basic Attacking burning enemies re-Ignites them. Cho is healed for 40 (+4% per level) when an enemy is Ignited.

abilities.name: Rune Bomb
abilities.description: Roll a bomb dealing 91 (+4% per level) damage to enemies in its path. Gall can use Runic Blast to detonate it to deal 210 (+4% per level) damage in an area.

abilities.name: Upheaval
abilities.description: After 1 second, pull enemies towards Cho'gall, Slowing them by 25% for 3 seconds and dealing 175 (+4% per level) damage.

abilities.name: Hammer of Twilight
abilities.description:
Activate to swing the Hammer of Twilight, dealing 150 (+4.5% per level) damage, pushing enemies away, and Stunning them for 0.75 seconds.

Passive: Cho's Basic Attacks deal 25% increased damage.

abilities.name: Frostmourne Hungers
abilities.description:
Activate to make Arthas's next Basic Attack strike immediately and deal 71 (+4% per level) bonus damage. Dealing damage restores 40 Mana.

Quest: Killing a Minion or hitting a Hero with Frostmourne Hungers permanently increases its bonus damage by 3 and Arthas's Basic Attack damage by 0.75.

abilities.name: Death Coil
abilities.description:
Deals 164 (+4% per level) damage to target enemy.

Can be self-cast to heal for 275 (+4% per level) Health.

abilities.name: Howling Blast
abilities.description: Root enemies within the target area for 1.25 seconds and deals 68 (+4% per level) damage.

abilities.name: Frozen Tempest
abilities.description: Deal 36 (+4% per level) damage per second to nearby enemies and Slow them by 10% per second, stacking up to 40%. Heroes hit also have their Attack Speed reduced by 10% per second, stacking up to 40%. Frozen Tempest's effects last for 1.5 seconds.

abilities.name: Army of the Dead
abilities.description:
Consume all charges to summon an equal number of Ghouls that lose Health over 20 seconds and attack for 20 (+4% per level) damage. Reactivate to sacrifice a ghoul, healing Arthas for 240 (+4% per level) Health. Stores up to 6 charges.

Whenever a nearby enemy Minion dies, reduce the charge cooldown of this Ability by 1 second. Takedowns reduce the charge cooldown of this Ability by 6 seconds.

abilities.name: Summon Sindragosa
abilities.description: Deals 230 (+4% per level) damage and Slows enemies by 60% for 4 seconds. Also disables Minions, Mercenaries, Monsters and Structures for 20 seconds.

abilities.name: Army of the Dead - Sacrifice
abilities.description: Sacrifice a Ghoul to restore 240 (+4% per level) Health.

abilities.name: Black Soulstone
abilities.description:
Repeatable Quest: Gain 10 Souls per Hero killed and 1 Soul per Minion, up to 100. For each Soul, gain 0.3% maximum Health. If Diablo has 100 Souls upon dying, he will resurrect in 5 seconds but lose 100 Souls.

After reaching level 10, Diablo only consumes 75 Souls when resurrecting.

abilities.name: Shadow Charge
abilities.description: Charge an enemy, knocking them back, dealing 45 (+4% per level) damage and gaining 15% Movement Speed for 2 seconds. If the enemy hits terrain, they are Stunned for 1 second and take an additional 140 (+4% per level) damage.

abilities.name: Fire Stomp
abilities.description: Unleashes fire waves toward the targeted area that deal 11 (+4% per level) damage each. Once they reach maximum range they return, dealing an additional 34 (+4% per level) damage. Diablo heals for 130% of the damage dealt to Heroes.

abilities.name: Overpower
abilities.description: Grabs the target and slams it behind Diablo, dealing 80 (+4% per level) damage and Stunning for 0.25 seconds.

abilities.name: Apocalypse
abilities.description: Create a demonic rune under each enemy Hero on the battleground. After 1.75 seconds the rune explodes dealing 137 (+4% per level) damage and Stunning them for 1.75 seconds.

abilities.name: Lightning Breath
abilities.description:
After 0.5 seconds, become Unstoppable and Channel for up to 4 seconds, dealing 50 (+4% per level) damage every 0.25 seconds to enemies in front of Diablo. Enemies affected are Slowed by 4% for 2 seconds, up to 40%. 

Lightning Breath's direction changes with your mouse cursor position.

abilities.name: Rockstar
abilities.description: Using a Basic Ability grants 25 Armor for 2 seconds. Heroic Abilities grant 50 Armor.

abilities.name: Powerslide
abilities.description: Slide to a location dealing 105 (+4% per level) damage and Stunning enemies hit for 1.25 seconds.

abilities.name: Face Melt
abilities.description: Deals 68 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies, knocking them back.

abilities.name: Guitar Solo
abilities.description: Regenerate 66 (+4% per level) Health per second for 4 seconds.

abilities.name: Mosh Pit
abilities.description: After 0.75 seconds, channel to stun nearby enemies for 4 seconds.

abilities.name: Stage Dive
abilities.description: Leap to target location, landing after 2.75 seconds, dealing 330 (+4% per level) damage to enemies in the area, and slowing them by 50% for 4 seconds.

abilities.name: Armor Up
abilities.description: Garrosh gains 1 Armor for every 2% of maximum Health missing.

abilities.name: Groundbreaker
abilities.description: Deal 81 (+4% per level) damage to enemies in an area. Heroes hit on the outer edge are Stunned for 0.5 seconds and then Slowed by 40% for 2 seconds.

abilities.name: Bloodthirst
abilities.description: Deal 156 (+4% per level) damage to an enemy and heal for 10% of Garrosh's missing Health. Healing is increased by 100% against Heroes.

abilities.name: Wrecking Ball
abilities.description: Throw a nearby enemy Hero, Minion, or Mercenary to the target location, dealing 91 (+4% per level) damage to enemies near the impact and Slowing them by 30% for 2.5 seconds.

abilities.name: Warlord's Challenge
abilities.description: Silence nearby Heroes and force them to attack Garrosh for 2 seconds.

abilities.name: Decimate
abilities.description:
Deal 50 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies and Slow them by 40% for 1.5 seconds. Deals 100% more damage to Heroes, and each Hero hit reduces the cooldown by 1 second.

Stores up to 3 charges.

abilities.name: Into the Fray
abilities.description:
Activate to throw a nearby ally and grant them 20 Armor for 3 seconds. Deals 91 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies upon impact and Slows them by 30% for 2.5 seconds.

While in flight, allied Heroes are Unstoppable.

abilities.name: Iron Skin
abilities.description: Activate to grant Johanna a Shield that absorbs 810 (+4% per level) damage for 4 seconds. While this Shield is active, Johanna is Unstoppable.

abilities.name: Punish
abilities.description: Step forward dealing 113 (+4% per level) damage and Slowing enemies by 50%, decaying over 2 seconds.

abilities.name: Condemn
abilities.description: After 1 second, Johanna pulls nearby enemies toward her, Stunning them for 0.25 seconds and dealing 55 (+4% per level) damage. Deals 200% increased damage to Minions and Mercenaries.

abilities.name: Shield Glare
abilities.description: Deal 59 (+4% per level) damage to enemies and Blind them for 1.5 seconds.

abilities.name: Falling Sword
abilities.description: Johanna leaps into the air for 2 seconds and she can steer the landing location by moving. While in the air, allies below Johanna are Unstoppable. Upon landing enemies hit take 225 (+4% per level) damage and are Stunned for 0.25 seconds.

abilities.name: Blessed Shield
abilities.description: Deal 114 (+4% per level) damage and Stun the first enemy hit for 1.5 seconds. Blessed Shield then bounces to 2 nearby enemies, dealing 57 (+4% per level) damage and Stunning them for 0.75 seconds.

abilities.name: Cryo-Freeze
abilities.description: Become encased in ice for 3 seconds, gaining a rapidly decaying Shield that absorbs up to 1104 (+4% per level) damage. While active, this Shield grants Unstoppable and restores up to 35% of Mei's maximum Health.

abilities.name: Snow Blind
abilities.description: Throw a snowball that hits all enemies in an area. Enemies hit take 70 (+4% per level) damage, are Slowed by 35%, and are Blinded for 1.75 seconds.

abilities.name: Blizzard
abilities.description: Command Snowball to create a Blizzard at the target location for 2 seconds. Enemies within the blizzard take 13 (+4% per level) damage every 0.25 seconds and are Slowed by 7%, stacking up to 35%. When the Blizzard ends, enemies within its area take an additional 75 (+4% per level) damage and are Stunned for 1.25 seconds.

abilities.name: Icing
abilities.description:
Slide quickly in the targeted direction. When this effect ends, enemies near Mei are knocked back, take 52 (+4% per level) damage, and are Slowed by 80%, rapidly decaying over 1.5 seconds.

Can be canceled during sliding.

abilities.name: Avalanche
abilities.description: After 0.5 seconds, roll a massive snowball that consumes enemy Heroes in its path. At the end of its path, the snowball crumbles, releasing the consumed Heroes, dealing 220 (+4% per level) damage and Stunning them for 0.5 seconds per Hero consumed.

abilities.name: Ice Wall
abilities.description:
Vector Targeting
After a 0.75 second delay, create an impassable wall that traps enemy Heroes hit for 2.5 seconds. When the wall expires, trapped Heroes are Slowed by 75%, decaying over 3 seconds.

abilities.name: Vampiric Touch
abilities.description: Mal'Ganis heals for 45% of damage dealt to enemy Heroes and 10% of damage dealt to non-Heroes.

abilities.name: Fel Claws
abilities.description:
Violently slash in the chosen direction, dealing 66 (+4% per level) damage to enemies.

Reactivate to slash up to 2 more times. The third slash Stuns enemies for 0.75 seconds.

abilities.name: Necrotic Embrace
abilities.description:
Desecrate the air, dealing 121 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies and gaining 15 Spell Armor for 3 Seconds.

This ability's base damage provides double healing from Vampiric Touch.

abilities.name: Night Rush
abilities.description: After 0.75 seconds, gain 50% Movement Speed for 2 seconds. While active, Mal'Ganis can move through enemy Heroes and put them to Sleep for 2.5 seconds.

abilities.name: Dark Conversion
abilities.description: Channel on an enemy Hero for 0.75 seconds, then swap Health percentages with the target over 3 seconds.

abilities.name: Carrion Swarm
abilities.description:
After 1 second, disperse into an Invulnerable swarm of bats for 3 seconds, dealing 120 (+4% per level) damage per second to enemies.

Vampiric Touch heals for 75% of Carrion Swarm's damage to Heroes.

abilities.name: Second Wind
abilities.description: Muradin restores 55 (+4% per level) Health per second when he has not taken damage for 4 seconds. When below 40% Health, increased to 111 (+4% per level) Health per second.

abilities.name: Storm Bolt
abilities.description:
Throw a hammer, dealing 110 (+4% per level) damage to the first enemy hit and Stunning them for 1.25 seconds

Quest: Basic Attack Heroes affected by Stuns, Slows, or Roots. Slowed or Rooted enemies grant 1 stack. Stunned enemies provide 2 stacks.  If the Hero dies within 3 seconds, gain 5 stacks.

Reward: Upon hitting 45 targets, Storm Bolt pierces to hit an additional target, and Muradin's Basic Attacks reduce the cooldown of Storm Bolt by 0.5 seconds.

Mythic Reward: Upon hitting 160 targets, Storm Bolt's range is increased by 50%, width increased by 100%, and now pierces all targets.

abilities.name: Thunder Clap
abilities.description: Blast nearby enemies for 96 (+4% per level) damage and Slow them by 30% for 2.5 seconds. Heroes hit also have their Attack Speed reduced by 30% for the duration.

abilities.name: Dwarf Toss
abilities.description: Leap to target location, dealing 59 (+4% per level) damage to enemies on landing. Upon leaping, gain 30 Armor for 2 seconds, reducing damage taken by 30%.

abilities.name: Avatar
abilities.description: Transform for 20 seconds, gaining 1000 (+4% per level) Health.

abilities.name: Haymaker
abilities.description: Stun target enemy Hero, and wind up a punch dealing 319 (+4% per level) damage and knocking the target back, hitting enemies in the way for 319 (+4% per level) damage and knocking them aside.

abilities.name: Shambling Horror
abilities.description:
Activate to spread Vile Gas in a large area every second and prevent your Movement Speed from being reduced below 110% for 4 seconds.

Vile Gas
Hitting enemies with Basic Attacks or the inner area of Slam afflicts them with Vile Gas, dealing an additional 36 (+4% per level) damage over 4 seconds. Deals 150% more damage to Minions, Mercenaries, and Monsters.

abilities.name: Hook
abilities.description:
Pull the first enemy hit towards Stitches and deal 91 (+4% per level) damage.

After reaching level 13, Hook's range is increased by 40%.

abilities.name: Slam
abilities.description: Deal 104 (+4% per level) damage to enemies within the target area. Enemies in the inner impact take 50% more damage and are Slowed by 45% for 2 seconds.

abilities.name: Devour
abilities.description: Deal 319 (+4% per level) damage to non-Heroic units, or 114 (+4% per level) damage to Heroes. Restores 20% of Stitches's maximum Health.

abilities.name: Putrid Bile
abilities.description: Emit bile that deals 37 (+4% per level) damage per second to enemies within, Slowing them by 35% for 1.5 seconds. Gain 20% Movement Speed while emitting bile. Lasts 8 seconds.

abilities.name: Gorge
abilities.description: Consume an enemy Hero, trapping them for 4 seconds. When Gorge ends, the enemy Hero takes 274 (+4% per level) damage. The trapped Hero cannot move or act and doesn't take damage from other sources.

abilities.name: Helping Hand
abilities.description:
Activate to use Hook that can hit allied Heroes. Hitting an allied Hero this way reduces the cooldown of Hook by 8 seconds.

After reaching level 13, Helping Hand's range is increased by 40%.

abilities.name: Archangel's Wrath
abilities.description:
Upon dying, become Invulnerable and gain 20% Movement Speed for 4 seconds. Upon expiration, explode, dealing 450 (+4% per level) damage and reducing Tyrael's death timer by 10% per enemy Hero hit.

Archangel's Wrath reduces nearby enemy Heroes' damage by 50% while active and for 3 seconds when it expires.

abilities.name: El'druin's Might
abilities.description: Throw El'druin to the target area, dealing 110 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies and Slowing them by 30% for 2.5 seconds. It can be reactivated within 5 seconds to teleport Tyrael to El'druin and Slow nearby enemies again.

abilities.name: Righteousness
abilities.description: Shields Tyrael for 350 (+4% per level) damage and nearby allied Heroes and Minions for 40% as much for 4 seconds.

abilities.name: Smite
abilities.description: Rake target area, dealing 150 (+4% per level) damage. For the next 3 seconds, allies moving through the targeted area gain 25% increased Movement Speed for 2 seconds.

abilities.name: Judgment
abilities.description: After 0.75 seconds, charge an enemy Hero, dealing 150 (+4% per level) damage and Stunning them for 1.5 seconds. Nearby enemies are knocked away and take 75 (+4% per level) damage.

abilities.name: Sanctification
abilities.description: After 0.5 seconds create a field of holy energy that makes allied Heroes Invulnerable. Lasts 3 seconds.

abilities.name: El'druin's Might - El'druin's Flash
abilities.description: Teleport to El'druin, slowing nearby enemies by 30% for 2 seconds.
